metadata.displayLabel: 本站编写的例句与用法
metadata.notice: 例句、中文译文、常见搭配和用法提示由本站编写，非考试真题；仅展示所选常见词义，原词典释义和来源信息保持不变。

fieldSemantics.example: Original natural English example for a common sense present in the base entry.
fieldSemantics.collocationsText: One collocation and Chinese gloss per line, separated by a middle dot.
fieldSemantics.usageNote: Concise Chinese usage guidance for the selected sense.

ecdict-adapt.example: New students need time to adapt to a different teaching style.
ecdict-adapt.exampleZh: 新生需要时间来适应不同的教学方式。
ecdict-adapt.collocationsText:
adapt to change · 适应变化
adapt a story for the stage · 把故事改编成舞台剧
ecdict-adapt.usageNote: 表示“适应”用 adapt to；adopt 则常指“采用”方法或政策。

ecdict-adopt.example: The school adopted a new method for teaching reading.
ecdict-adopt.exampleZh: 学校采用了一种新的阅读教学方法。
ecdict-adopt.collocationsText:
adopt a method · 采用一种方法
adopt a policy · 采取一项政策
ecdict-adopt.usageNote: adopt 表示“采用”；adapt 表示“适应”或“改编”，注意不要混用。

ecdict-acquire.example: She acquired practical skills through a series of small projects.
ecdict-acquire.exampleZh: 她通过一系列小项目学到了实用技能。
ecdict-acquire.collocationsText:
acquire knowledge · 获得知识
acquire a skill · 学会一项技能
ecdict-acquire.usageNote: knowledge 表示“知识”时不可数；skill 表示具体技能时可数。

ecdict-accurate.example: Keep an accurate record of how much time you spend on each task.
ecdict-accurate.exampleZh: 准确记录你在每项任务上花费的时间。
ecdict-accurate.collocationsText:
accurate information · 准确的信息
an accurate description · 准确的描述
ecdict-accurate.usageNote: accurate 强调符合事实或正确无误；precise 更强调细节或数值的精确。

ecdict-adequate.example: The room has adequate space for a small study group.
ecdict-adequate.exampleZh: 这个房间有足够的空间供一个小型学习小组使用。
ecdict-adequate.collocationsText:
adequate space · 足够的空间
adequate preparation · 充分的准备
ecdict-adequate.usageNote: adequate 表示足以满足某种需要，不一定表示“很好”或“优秀”。

ecdict-allocate.example: We allocated the first ten minutes to reviewing yesterday's notes.
ecdict-allocate.exampleZh: 我们把最初十分钟安排用来复习昨天的笔记。
ecdict-allocate.collocationsText:
allocate time to a task · 为任务分配时间
allocate resources · 分配资源
ecdict-allocate.usageNote: 常用 allocate something to someone/something，表示把某物分配给某人或某事。

ecdict-annual.example: The annual report describes the library's most popular activities.
ecdict-annual.exampleZh: 年度报告介绍了图书馆最受欢迎的活动。
ecdict-annual.collocationsText:
an annual report · 年度报告
an annual meeting · 年会
ecdict-annual.usageNote: annual 表示“每年的”；annually 是副词，表示“每年一次”。

ecdict-appropriate.example: Choose a writing style that is appropriate for your readers.
ecdict-appropriate.exampleZh: 选择适合你的读者的写作风格。
ecdict-appropriate.collocationsText:
appropriate for the audience · 适合受众的
an appropriate response · 恰当的回应
ecdict-appropriate.usageNote: 表示“适合某人或某种场合”常用 appropriate for。

ecdict-approximate.example: Please give an approximate number of people who will attend.
ecdict-approximate.exampleZh: 请提供预计出席人数的大致数字。
ecdict-approximate.collocationsText:
an approximate number · 大致的数量
an approximate date · 大致的日期
ecdict-approximate.usageNote: 这里 approximate 是形容词；修饰数字时用副词 approximately，如 approximately 20 people。

ecdict-argument.example: Her essay presents a clear argument for improving public transport.
ecdict-argument.exampleZh: 她的文章清楚地论证了改善公共交通的必要性。
ecdict-argument.collocationsText:
an argument for something · 支持某事的论据
an argument against something · 反对某事的论据
ecdict-argument.usageNote: 这里 argument 指“论证、论据”，不是“争吵”；for 表示支持，against 表示反对。

ecdict-attitude.example: His attitude towards group work became more positive over time.
ecdict-attitude.exampleZh: 随着时间推移，他对小组合作的态度变得更加积极。
ecdict-attitude.collocationsText:
a positive attitude · 积极的态度
attitude towards learning · 对学习的态度
ecdict-attitude.usageNote: 表示“对……的态度”可用 attitude to 或 attitude towards。

ecdict-aware.example: Many students were not aware of the library's evening opening hours.
ecdict-aware.exampleZh: 许多学生不知道图书馆晚间的开放时间。
ecdict-aware.collocationsText:
be aware of a problem · 意识到一个问题
be fully aware · 充分意识到
ecdict-aware.usageNote: 常用 be aware of something 或 be aware that…，不用 aware about。

ecdict-capacity.example: The course helped me develop my capacity to work independently.
ecdict-capacity.exampleZh: 这门课帮助我提高了独立工作的能力。
ecdict-capacity.collocationsText:
the capacity to learn · 学习能力
storage capacity · 存储容量
ecdict-capacity.usageNote: 表示“做某事的能力”常用 capacity to do something；capacity 也可指容量。

ecdict-category.example: Each response was placed in a category according to its main topic.
ecdict-category.exampleZh: 每条回答都按照其主要话题被归入一个类别。
ecdict-category.collocationsText:
fall into a category · 属于某一类别
a broad category · 宽泛的类别
ecdict-category.usageNote: category 是可数名词，复数为 categories。

ecdict-circumstance.example: Under these circumstances, we decided to hold the meeting online.
ecdict-circumstance.exampleZh: 在这种情况下，我们决定在线上开会。
ecdict-circumstance.collocationsText:
under the circumstances · 在这种情况下
personal circumstances · 个人情况
ecdict-circumstance.usageNote: 表示某人所处的“情况、境况”时，通常用复数 circumstances。

ecdict-clarify.example: Could you clarify what you mean by a successful outcome?
ecdict-clarify.exampleZh: 你能说明一下，你所说的成功结果具体指什么吗？
ecdict-clarify.collocationsText:
clarify a point · 把某一点讲清楚
clarify the meaning · 澄清含义
ecdict-clarify.usageNote: clarify 后可直接接宾语，如 clarify the instructions；不必加 about。

ecdict-combine.example: The course combines short lectures with practical exercises.
ecdict-combine.exampleZh: 这门课把简短的讲授与实践练习结合起来。
ecdict-combine.collocationsText:
combine theory with practice · 将理论与实践结合
combine different methods · 综合不同方法
ecdict-combine.usageNote: 常用 combine A with B，也可用 combine A and B。

ecdict-complex.example: The article explains a complex idea through a familiar example.
ecdict-complex.exampleZh: 这篇文章通过一个熟悉的例子解释了一个复杂的概念。
ecdict-complex.collocationsText:
a complex issue · 复杂的问题
a complex system · 复杂的系统
ecdict-complex.usageNote: complex 常强调组成部分多且相互关联；complicated 常强调难以理解或处理。

ecdict-concentrate.example: I find it easier to concentrate on reading when my phone is out of reach.
ecdict-concentrate.exampleZh: 手机放在够不到的地方时，我觉得更容易专心阅读。
ecdict-concentrate.collocationsText:
concentrate on a task · 专心做一项任务
concentrate your efforts on something · 集中精力做某事
ecdict-concentrate.usageNote: concentrate on 后接名词或动名词，如 concentrate on studying。

ecdict-concept.example: The teacher used a simple diagram to explain the concept of probability.
ecdict-concept.exampleZh: 老师用一幅简单的图来解释概率的概念。
ecdict-concept.collocationsText:
a key concept · 核心概念
the concept of something · ……的概念
ecdict-concept.usageNote: concept 是可数名词，泛指一个概念时可用 a concept。

ecdict-consistent.example: The results are consistent with what we observed in the classroom.
ecdict-consistent.exampleZh: 这些结果与我们在课堂上观察到的情况一致。
ecdict-consistent.collocationsText:
consistent with the evidence · 与证据一致
consistent performance · 稳定的表现
ecdict-consistent.usageNote: 表示“与……一致”用 consistent with；表示表现稳定也可用 consistent。

ecdict-constitute.example: These three sections constitute the main part of the report.
ecdict-constitute.exampleZh: 这三个章节构成了报告的主体。
ecdict-constitute.collocationsText:
constitute a problem · 构成问题
constitute the majority · 占多数
ecdict-constitute.usageNote: constitute 表示“构成”时直接接宾语，不用 constitute of。

ecdict-context.example: It is easier to understand an unfamiliar word when you read it in context.
ecdict-context.exampleZh: 结合上下文阅读时，更容易理解一个生词。
ecdict-context.collocationsText:
in context · 结合上下文
the social context · 社会背景
ecdict-context.usageNote: in context 表示结合上下文；out of context 表示脱离上下文。

ecdict-contrast.example: The essay explores the contrast between city life and village life.
ecdict-contrast.exampleZh: 这篇文章探讨了城市生活与乡村生活的差异。
ecdict-contrast.collocationsText:
a contrast between A and B · A 与 B 之间的差异
in contrast to something · 与某事物相比
ecdict-contrast.usageNote: between 后用 A and B；in contrast to 和 in contrast with 都可表示“与……相比”。

ecdict-conventional.example: The team tried a new approach when conventional methods failed.
ecdict-conventional.exampleZh: 常规方法未能奏效后，团队尝试了一种新方法。
ecdict-conventional.collocationsText:
conventional methods · 常规方法
conventional wisdom · 普遍接受的看法
ecdict-conventional.usageNote: conventional 强调常规或普遍接受；traditional 更强调传统或长期沿袭。

ecdict-convince.example: The examples convinced me that the proposal was worth considering.
ecdict-convince.exampleZh: 这些例子让我相信，这项提议值得考虑。
ecdict-convince.collocationsText:
convince someone of something · 使某人确信某事
convince someone that… · 使某人相信……
ecdict-convince.usageNote: 常用 convince someone of something 或 convince someone that…，表示使某人确信某事。

ecdict-criterion.example: Clarity is an important criterion for judging a student essay.
ecdict-criterion.exampleZh: 清晰度是评判学生文章的一项重要标准。
ecdict-criterion.collocationsText:
a selection criterion · 选拔标准
meet the criteria · 符合标准
ecdict-criterion.usageNote: criterion 是单数，criteria 是复数：one criterion，several criteria。

ecdict-define.example: At the start of the project, we defined the roles of each team member.
ecdict-define.exampleZh: 项目开始时，我们明确了每位团队成员的职责。
ecdict-define.collocationsText:
define a term · 定义一个术语
clearly defined roles · 明确界定的职责
ecdict-define.usageNote: define A as B 表示“把 A 定义为 B”。

ecdict-demonstrate.example: The teacher demonstrated how to organize notes into a clear outline.
ecdict-demonstrate.exampleZh: 老师示范了如何把笔记整理成清晰的提纲。
ecdict-demonstrate.collocationsText:
demonstrate a technique · 演示一种技巧
demonstrate an ability · 展现一种能力
ecdict-demonstrate.usageNote: demonstrate 后可接 how 从句，表示演示如何做某事；也可接 that 从句，表示表明某事。

ecdict-derive.example: The project derives its name from a local river.
ecdict-derive.exampleZh: 这个项目的名字来自当地的一条河流。
ecdict-derive.collocationsText:
derive from something · 源自某事物
derive benefit from something · 从某事物中获益
ecdict-derive.usageNote: “源自”用 derive from；“从……获得……”用 derive something from something。

ecdict-determine.example: Your purpose will determine which details you include in the summary.
ecdict-determine.exampleZh: 你的目的将决定你在摘要中纳入哪些细节。
ecdict-determine.collocationsText:
determine the outcome · 决定结果
determine the cause · 查明原因
ecdict-determine.usageNote: determine 可表示“决定”或“查明”；be determined to do 表示“决心做”。

ecdict-distinguish.example: Readers should distinguish between the writer's opinion and the evidence.
ecdict-distinguish.exampleZh: 读者应当区分作者的观点与证据。
ecdict-distinguish.collocationsText:
distinguish A from B · 区分 A 和 B
distinguish between A and B · 区分 A 与 B
ecdict-distinguish.usageNote: 常用 distinguish A from B 或 distinguish between A and B。

ecdict-diverse.example: The discussion brought together students with diverse interests.
ecdict-diverse.exampleZh: 这场讨论聚集了兴趣各异的学生。
ecdict-diverse.collocationsText:
diverse backgrounds · 不同的背景
a diverse range of views · 多种不同的观点
ecdict-diverse.usageNote: diverse 强调多样性；different 只说明彼此不同，不一定强调种类丰富。

ecdict-enable.example: The shared document enables everyone to contribute ideas before the meeting.
ecdict-enable.exampleZh: 这份共享文档让所有人都能在会前贡献想法。
ecdict-enable.collocationsText:
enable someone to learn · 使某人能够学习
enable access · 使访问成为可能
ecdict-enable.usageNote: 用 enable someone to do something，不用 enable someone do something。

ecdict-encounter.example: We encountered several unexpected problems while organizing the event.
ecdict-encounter.exampleZh: 组织活动时，我们遇到了几个意想不到的问题。
ecdict-encounter.collocationsText:
encounter a problem · 遇到问题
encounter difficulties · 遇到困难
ecdict-encounter.usageNote: encounter 作动词时直接接宾语，如 encounter a problem，不加 with。

ecdict-enhance.example: Clear headings can enhance the readability of a long report.
ecdict-enhance.exampleZh: 清晰的标题能提高长篇报告的可读性。
ecdict-enhance.collocationsText:
enhance understanding · 增进理解
enhance the quality · 提高质量
ecdict-enhance.usageNote: enhance 常指使已有的优点、质量或效果进一步提升。

ecdict-ensure.example: Please check the file name to ensure that you upload the correct version.
ecdict-ensure.exampleZh: 请核对文件名，确保你上传的是正确版本。
ecdict-ensure.collocationsText:
ensure that… · 确保……
ensure consistency · 确保一致性
ecdict-ensure.usageNote: ensure that… 表示确保某事发生；assure someone that… 表示向某人保证。

ecdict-establish.example: The group established a routine of reviewing progress every Friday.
ecdict-establish.exampleZh: 小组形成了每周五回顾进展的惯例。
ecdict-establish.collocationsText:
establish a routine · 形成惯例
establish a relationship · 建立关系
ecdict-establish.usageNote: establish 可指建立制度或关系；与事实搭配时也可指“查明、证实”。

ecdict-estimate.example: We estimate that the discussion will take about forty minutes.
ecdict-estimate.exampleZh: 我们估计这场讨论大约需要四十分钟。
ecdict-estimate.collocationsText:
estimate the cost · 估计费用
a rough estimate · 粗略估计
ecdict-estimate.usageNote: estimate 侧重估计数量、时间或费用；evaluate 侧重评价质量、价值或效果。

ecdict-evaluate.example: Students evaluated the usefulness of the feedback before revising their work.
ecdict-evaluate.exampleZh: 学生们先评估反馈意见的实用性，再修改自己的作业。
ecdict-evaluate.collocationsText:
evaluate the effectiveness · 评估效果
evaluate the evidence · 评估证据
ecdict-evaluate.usageNote: evaluate 表示评价价值、质量或效果；estimate 常用于估计数值。

ecdict-expose.example: Reading different authors can expose you to new ways of thinking.
ecdict-expose.exampleZh: 阅读不同作者的作品可以让你接触新的思维方式。
ecdict-expose.collocationsText:
expose someone to new ideas · 让某人接触新观点
be exposed to something · 接触到某事物
ecdict-expose.usageNote: 常用 expose someone to something；这里表示接触，不表示揭穿。

ecdict-identify.example: The survey helped us identify the main reasons for the delays.
ecdict-identify.exampleZh: 这项调查帮助我们找出了造成延误的主要原因。
ecdict-identify.collocationsText:
identify a problem · 找出问题
identify the cause · 确定原因
ecdict-identify.usageNote: identify something as… 表示认定某物为……；identify with someone 表示认同某人。

ecdict-ignore.example: The report ignores the difficulties faced by people without internet access.
ecdict-ignore.exampleZh: 这份报告忽视了无法上网的人所面临的困难。
ecdict-ignore.collocationsText:
ignore a warning · 无视警告
ignore the evidence · 忽视证据
ecdict-ignore.usageNote: ignore 常表示不予理会或未加考虑；be ignorant of 表示不知道某事。

ecdict-imply.example: A longer essay does not necessarily imply a better argument.
ecdict-imply.exampleZh: 文章更长并不一定意味着论证更好。
ecdict-imply.collocationsText:
imply that… · 暗示或意味着……
not necessarily imply · 不一定意味着
ecdict-imply.usageNote: imply 是说话者或事实“暗示”；infer 是读者或听者“推断”。

ecdict-interpret.example: Different readers may interpret the same passage in different ways.
ecdict-interpret.exampleZh: 不同读者可能会以不同方式理解同一段文字。
ecdict-interpret.collocationsText:
interpret the results · 解读结果
interpret something as something · 将某事理解为某种含义
ecdict-interpret.usageNote: 用 interpret A as B 表示“把 A 理解为 B”。

ecdict-involve.example: The course involves reading short articles and discussing them in groups.
ecdict-involve.exampleZh: 这门课包括阅读短文和分组讨论。
ecdict-involve.collocationsText:
involve doing something · 涉及做某事
be involved in a project · 参与一个项目
ecdict-involve.usageNote: involve 后接动名词，如 involve reading，不用 involve to read。

ecdict-justify.example: The author uses several examples to justify her conclusion.
ecdict-justify.exampleZh: 作者用几个例子来论证自己的结论是合理的。
ecdict-justify.collocationsText:
justify a decision · 证明一项决定合理
justify doing something · 证明做某事合理
ecdict-justify.usageNote: justify 后接名词或动名词，如 justify changing the plan，不接 to do。

ecdict-objective.example: Our main objective is to make the guide easy for new students to use.
ecdict-objective.exampleZh: 我们的主要目标是让新生能够轻松使用这份指南。
ecdict-objective.collocationsText:
achieve an objective · 实现目标
a clear objective · 明确的目标
ecdict-objective.usageNote: 这里 objective 是可数名词，意为“目标”；作形容词时表示“客观的”。

ecdict-obtain.example: You can obtain a copy of the reading list from the course website.
ecdict-obtain.exampleZh: 你可以从课程网站获取一份阅读书目。
ecdict-obtain.collocationsText:
obtain information · 获取信息
obtain permission · 获得许可
ecdict-obtain.usageNote: obtain 较正式，通常可以换成 get；permission 表示许可时一般不可数。

ecdict-occur.example: Most spelling errors occur when I write too quickly.
ecdict-occur.exampleZh: 我的大多数拼写错误都出现在写得太快的时候。
ecdict-occur.collocationsText:
occur frequently · 频繁发生
occur to someone · 被某人想到
ecdict-occur.usageNote: occur 表示“发生”时是不及物动词，不用 be occurred。

ecdict-perspective.example: Working with younger students gave me a new perspective on learning.
ecdict-perspective.exampleZh: 与年龄更小的学生合作，让我对学习有了新的看法。
ecdict-perspective.collocationsText:
a perspective on something · 对某事的看法
from a different perspective · 从不同角度
ecdict-perspective.usageNote: “从某个角度”用 from a perspective；“对某事的看法”可用 a perspective on something。

ecdict-previous.example: This year's reading list includes several books from the previous year.
ecdict-previous.exampleZh: 今年的阅读书目包含了前一年的几本书。
ecdict-previous.collocationsText:
the previous year · 前一年
previous experience · 以往的经验
ecdict-previous.usageNote: previous 通常相对于文中提到的时间；last year 通常指相对于现在的“去年”。

ecdict-promote.example: The new discussion format is designed to promote active participation.
ecdict-promote.exampleZh: 新的讨论形式旨在促进大家积极参与。
ecdict-promote.collocationsText:
promote cooperation · 促进合作
promote understanding · 增进理解
ecdict-promote.usageNote: promote 可指促进；promote someone to a position 则表示把某人晋升到某职位。

ecdict-proportion.example: A large proportion of the responses focused on the same issue.
ecdict-proportion.exampleZh: 很大一部分回答都集中在同一个问题上。
ecdict-proportion.collocationsText:
a large proportion of something · 某事物中的很大一部分
in proportion to something · 与某事物成比例
ecdict-proportion.usageNote: a proportion of 后可接复数名词或不可数名词；谓语通常与 of 后所指的事物一致。

ecdict-relevant.example: Include only the details that are relevant to your main argument.
ecdict-relevant.exampleZh: 只纳入与你的主要论点相关的细节。
ecdict-relevant.collocationsText:
relevant to the topic · 与主题相关的
relevant information · 相关信息
ecdict-relevant.usageNote: 表示“与……相关”用 relevant to，不用 relevant with。

ecdict-rely.example: Do not rely on a single example to support a general claim.
ecdict-rely.exampleZh: 不要仅靠一个例子来支持一个概括性的论断。
ecdict-rely.collocationsText:
rely on evidence · 依靠证据
rely on someone to do something · 指望某人做某事
ecdict-rely.usageNote: 常用 rely on，也可用较正式的 rely upon；不用 rely of。

ecdict-retain.example: A short review after class helps me retain new vocabulary.
ecdict-retain.exampleZh: 课后简短的复习有助于我记住新词汇。
ecdict-retain.collocationsText:
retain information · 记住信息
retain the original meaning · 保留原意
ecdict-retain.usageNote: retain 强调继续保有或记住；regain 表示失去之后重新获得。

ecdict-reveal.example: The interviews revealed a wide range of views on the new schedule.
ecdict-reveal.exampleZh: 访谈显示，人们对新安排有各种不同的看法。
ecdict-reveal.collocationsText:
reveal a pattern · 揭示一种规律
reveal that… · 表明……
ecdict-reveal.usageNote: 向某人透露某事用 reveal something to someone，不用 reveal someone something。

ecdict-sufficient.example: We did not have sufficient time to discuss every suggestion.
ecdict-sufficient.exampleZh: 我们没有足够的时间讨论每一条建议。
ecdict-sufficient.collocationsText:
sufficient time · 足够的时间
sufficient evidence · 充分的证据
ecdict-sufficient.usageNote: sufficient for 后接名词；sufficient to 后可接动词原形，如 sufficient to finish the task。

ecdict-vary.example: The length of each chapter varies according to its topic.
ecdict-vary.exampleZh: 每章的篇幅因主题而异。
ecdict-vary.collocationsText:
vary from person to person · 因人而异
vary according to something · 随某事物而变化
ecdict-vary.usageNote: vary 表示“有所不同、变化”；vary from A to B 可表示在 A 与 B 之间变化。

ecdict-abstract.example: The abstract gives readers a brief overview of the study.
ecdict-abstract.exampleZh: 摘要让读者对这项研究有一个简要的了解。
ecdict-abstract.collocationsText:
write an abstract · 撰写摘要
a conference abstract · 会议论文摘要
ecdict-abstract.usageNote: 此处 abstract 是可数名词，指论文等的“摘要”；作形容词时可表示“抽象的”。

ecdict-access.example: Students have free access to the library's online journals.
ecdict-access.exampleZh: 学生可以免费使用图书馆的在线期刊。
ecdict-access.collocationsText:
access to information · 获取信息的机会
gain access to a database · 获得数据库的使用权限
ecdict-access.usageNote: 作名词表示“使用权”时通常不可数，后接 to；常说 have access to。

ecdict-analyze.example: The class will analyze the results before writing a report.
ecdict-analyze.exampleZh: 全班将在撰写报告之前分析结果。
ecdict-analyze.collocationsText:
analyze data · 分析数据
analyze a problem · 分析问题
ecdict-analyze.usageNote: analyze 是及物动词，可直接接分析对象；英式拼写通常为 analyse。

ecdict-aspect.example: The project explores the social aspects of urban development.
ecdict-aspect.exampleZh: 这个项目探讨城市发展的社会层面。
ecdict-aspect.collocationsText:
an important aspect · 一个重要方面
aspects of daily life · 日常生活的各个方面
ecdict-aspect.usageNote: aspect 表示“方面”时可数；“某事的一个方面”常用 an aspect of something。

ecdict-assess.example: The teacher used a short quiz to assess students' understanding.
ecdict-assess.exampleZh: 老师用一个简短的测验来评估学生的理解情况。
ecdict-assess.collocationsText:
assess progress · 评估进展
assess the quality of work · 评估工作质量
ecdict-assess.usageNote: assess 可直接接评估对象；常用于能力、质量、进展或风险等。

ecdict-assume.example: We should not assume that every student has a quiet place to study.
ecdict-assume.exampleZh: 我们不应假定每个学生都有安静的学习场所。
ecdict-assume.collocationsText:
assume that something is true · 假定某事属实
assume responsibility · 承担责任
ecdict-assume.usageNote: assume that 后接完整从句，表示把某事当作前提；assume responsibility 中则表示“承担”。

ecdict-benefit.example: Students can benefit from discussing their ideas with classmates.
ecdict-benefit.exampleZh: 学生可以从与同学讨论想法中受益。
ecdict-benefit.collocationsText:
benefit from feedback · 从反馈中受益
a practical benefit · 一项实际好处
ecdict-benefit.usageNote: “从……中受益”用 benefit from；benefit 也可作可数名词，表示“好处”。

ecdict-bias.example: The reviewers did not see the authors' names, which helped reduce bias.
ecdict-bias.exampleZh: 评审人员没有看到作者的姓名，这有助于减少偏见。
ecdict-bias.collocationsText:
reduce bias · 减少偏见
cultural bias · 文化偏见
ecdict-bias.usageNote: bias 可指影响判断的偏见；说“对某人或某群体的偏见”常用 bias against。

ecdict-challenge.example: Finding enough participants was the main challenge for the research team.
ecdict-challenge.exampleZh: 找到足够的参与者是研究团队面临的主要挑战。
ecdict-challenge.collocationsText:
face a challenge · 面临挑战
meet a challenge · 应对挑战
ecdict-challenge.usageNote: challenge 表示“挑战”时是可数名词；可说 a challenge for someone。

ecdict-conclude.example: After reviewing the interviews, the team concluded that clearer instructions were needed.
ecdict-conclude.exampleZh: 审阅访谈内容后，团队得出结论：需要更清楚的说明。
ecdict-conclude.collocationsText:
conclude that something is necessary · 得出某事有必要的结论
conclude from the evidence · 根据证据得出结论
ecdict-conclude.usageNote: 表示“得出结论”时常接 that 从句；conclude from 后接作出判断所依据的信息。

ecdict-conduct.example: The students conducted a survey about study habits.
ecdict-conduct.exampleZh: 学生们开展了一项关于学习习惯的调查。
ecdict-conduct.collocationsText:
conduct a survey · 开展调查
conduct an experiment · 进行实验
ecdict-conduct.usageNote: 此处 conduct 是动词，表示“实施、开展”，常与调查、研究和实验等搭配。

ecdict-consequence.example: The report discusses the possible consequences of closing the local library.
ecdict-consequence.exampleZh: 报告讨论了关闭当地图书馆可能带来的后果。
ecdict-consequence.collocationsText:
a direct consequence · 直接后果
consider the consequences · 考虑后果
ecdict-consequence.usageNote: “……的后果”常用 a consequence of；consequence 常指不利后果，但也可中性地表示结果。

ecdict-consider.example: Before choosing a topic, consider how much evidence you can find.
ecdict-consider.exampleZh: 选择题目之前，要考虑你能找到多少证据。
ecdict-consider.collocationsText:
consider an option · 考虑一个选项
consider doing research · 考虑开展研究
ecdict-consider.usageNote: 表示“考虑做某事”用 consider doing something，一般不用 consider to do。

ecdict-considerable.example: The team spent considerable time checking the references.
ecdict-considerable.exampleZh: 团队花了相当多的时间核对参考文献。
ecdict-considerable.collocationsText:
considerable effort · 相当大的努力
a considerable difference · 相当大的差异
ecdict-considerable.usageNote: considerable 表示数量或程度“相当大”；不要与表示“体贴的”的 considerate 混淆。

ecdict-contribute.example: Each group member contributed one example to the final presentation.
ecdict-contribute.exampleZh: 每位小组成员都为最终展示提供了一个例子。
ecdict-contribute.collocationsText:
contribute to a discussion · 参与讨论并提出意见
contribute ideas · 提供想法
ecdict-contribute.usageNote: “为……提供某物”可用 contribute something to something；contribute to 也可表示“促成”。

ecdict-create.example: The new reading room creates more space for group study.
ecdict-create.exampleZh: 新的阅览室为小组学习提供了更多空间。
ecdict-create.collocationsText:
create opportunities · 创造机会
create a model · 创建模型
ecdict-create.usageNote: create 常表示创造或使某事物产生，后面直接接宾语。

ecdict-culture.example: The course examines how language reflects culture.
ecdict-culture.exampleZh: 这门课程探讨语言如何反映文化。
ecdict-culture.collocationsText:
local culture · 当地文化
a shared culture · 共同的文化
ecdict-culture.usageNote: culture 泛指“文化”时常不可数；指某一种文化时可数，如 different cultures。

ecdict-data.example: These data show a clear difference between the two groups.
ecdict-data.exampleZh: 这些数据显示两组之间存在明显差异。
ecdict-data.collocationsText:
collect data · 收集数据
analyze data · 分析数据
ecdict-data.usageNote: 正式学术写作中 data 常按复数处理，如 these data show；单数用法也很常见，应遵循所用写作规范。

ecdict-debate.example: The proposal led to a lively debate in class.
ecdict-debate.exampleZh: 这项提议引发了热烈的课堂讨论。
ecdict-debate.collocationsText:
a public debate · 一场公开辩论
debate an issue · 讨论一个问题
ecdict-debate.usageNote: debate 可作名词或动词；作动词时可直接接议题，也可用 debate whether 引出争论的问题。

ecdict-decline.example: Attendance at the weekly lecture declined during the exam period.
ecdict-decline.exampleZh: 考试期间，每周讲座的出席人数有所下降。
ecdict-decline.collocationsText:
a decline in attendance · 出席人数的下降
decline steadily · 持续下降
ecdict-decline.usageNote: 此处 decline 表示“下降”；作名词时常用 a decline in 加下降的指标。

ecdict-design.example: The course teaches students how to design a simple experiment.
ecdict-design.exampleZh: 这门课程教学生如何设计一个简单的实验。
ecdict-design.collocationsText:
design an experiment · 设计实验
a research design · 研究设计
ecdict-design.usageNote: design 可作动词或名词；be designed to do something 表示“旨在做某事”。

ecdict-distribute.example: The teacher distributed the worksheets among the groups.
ecdict-distribute.exampleZh: 老师把练习单分发给各个小组。
ecdict-distribute.collocationsText:
distribute materials · 分发材料
distribute resources evenly · 均匀分配资源
ecdict-distribute.usageNote: distribute 表示“分发、分配”；可用 distribute something to people，也可用 among 表示在多人或多组之间分配。

ecdict-economy.example: The essay examines the role of small businesses in the local economy.
ecdict-economy.exampleZh: 这篇文章探讨小企业在当地经济中的作用。
ecdict-economy.collocationsText:
the local economy · 当地经济
a growing economy · 不断发展的经济体
ecdict-economy.usageNote: economy 指一个地区或国家的经济体系；economics 通常指“经济学”。

ecdict-efficient.example: An efficient filing system helps researchers find their notes quickly.
ecdict-efficient.exampleZh: 高效的文件归档系统能帮助研究人员迅速找到笔记。
ecdict-efficient.collocationsText:
an efficient system · 高效的系统
efficient use of time · 高效利用时间
ecdict-efficient.usageNote: efficient 强调少浪费时间或资源；effective 强调能够达到预期效果。

ecdict-emerge.example: A common theme emerged from the interviews.
ecdict-emerge.exampleZh: 这些访谈呈现出一个共同主题。
ecdict-emerge.collocationsText:
emerge from the data · 从数据中显现
new questions emerge · 新问题出现
ecdict-emerge.usageNote: emerge 是不及物动词；常用 emerge from 表示从某处出现或从某些材料中显现。

ecdict-emphasize.example: The lecturer emphasized the importance of checking original sources.
ecdict-emphasize.exampleZh: 讲师强调了核查原始来源的重要性。
ecdict-emphasize.collocationsText:
emphasize a point · 强调一个要点
emphasize the importance of accuracy · 强调准确性的重要性
ecdict-emphasize.usageNote: emphasize 是及物动词，直接接宾语；名词结构则可用 put emphasis on。

ecdict-environment.example: The school aims to provide a supportive learning environment.
ecdict-environment.exampleZh: 学校致力于提供一个能给予学生支持的学习环境。
ecdict-environment.collocationsText:
a learning environment · 学习环境
protect the environment · 保护环境
ecdict-environment.usageNote: environment 指具体的学习或工作环境时可数；the environment 常指自然环境。

ecdict-evidence.example: The essay needs more evidence to support its main argument.
ecdict-evidence.exampleZh: 这篇文章需要更多证据来支持其主要论点。
ecdict-evidence.collocationsText:
strong evidence · 有力证据
provide evidence · 提供证据
ecdict-evidence.usageNote: evidence 通常是不可数名词；“一条证据”用 a piece of evidence，不说 an evidence。

ecdict-factor.example: Travel time was an important factor in our choice of venue.
ecdict-factor.exampleZh: 交通耗时是我们选择场地时考虑的一个重要因素。
ecdict-factor.collocationsText:
a key factor · 关键因素
a contributing factor · 促成因素
ecdict-factor.usageNote: factor 表示“因素”时可数；“某事中的一个因素”常用 a factor in。

ecdict-focus.example: This chapter focuses on the relationship between language and memory.
ecdict-focus.exampleZh: 本章重点讨论语言与记忆之间的关系。
ecdict-focus.collocationsText:
focus on a question · 重点关注一个问题
the main focus · 主要关注点
ecdict-focus.usageNote: 作动词表示“集中于、重点关注”时常用 focus on；on 后可接名词或动名词。

ecdict-function.example: The introduction explains the function of each part of the device.
ecdict-function.exampleZh: 引言说明了该装置各个部件的功能。
ecdict-function.collocationsText:
perform a function · 发挥作用
the main function · 主要功能
ecdict-function.usageNote: function 作名词表示“功能”时可数；作动词可表示“运转、起作用”。

ecdict-hypothesis.example: The experiment was designed to test the hypothesis that light affects plant growth.
ecdict-hypothesis.exampleZh: 这项实验旨在检验光照会影响植物生长这一假设。
ecdict-hypothesis.collocationsText:
test a hypothesis · 检验假设
support a hypothesis · 支持假设
ecdict-hypothesis.usageNote: hypothesis 指有待检验的假设，复数是 hypotheses；有证据支持不等于已经最终证实。

ecdict-illustrate.example: The diagram illustrates how water moves through the system.
ecdict-illustrate.exampleZh: 这张图说明了水如何流经这个系统。
ecdict-illustrate.collocationsText:
illustrate a point · 阐明一个要点
illustrate with an example · 用例子说明
ecdict-illustrate.usageNote: illustrate 可表示通过图示或例子说明；常用 illustrate how 加从句。

ecdict-impact.example: The report examines the impact of the new timetable on students.
ecdict-impact.exampleZh: 报告考察了新课表对学生的影响。
ecdict-impact.collocationsText:
have an impact on learning · 对学习产生影响
a lasting impact · 持久的影响
ecdict-impact.usageNote: 名词 impact 常与 on 搭配，表示“对……的影响”；如 have an impact on。

ecdict-indicate.example: The results indicate that the second method is more reliable.
ecdict-indicate.exampleZh: 结果表明，第二种方法更可靠。
ecdict-indicate.collocationsText:
indicate a change · 显示变化
indicate that something is possible · 表明某事有可能
ecdict-indicate.usageNote: indicate 常用于描述数据、结果或迹象所表明的情况，可接名词或 that 从句。

ecdict-individual.example: The tutor gave each student feedback on their individual progress.
ecdict-individual.exampleZh: 导师就每位学生各自的进步情况给出了反馈。
ecdict-individual.collocationsText:
individual needs · 个人需求
individual differences · 个体差异
ecdict-individual.usageNote: individual 作形容词强调“个别的、每个人各自的”；作名词时指“个人、个体”。

ecdict-influence.example: The study explores how family routines influence children's reading habits.
ecdict-influence.exampleZh: 这项研究探讨家庭日常安排如何影响儿童的阅读习惯。
ecdict-influence.collocationsText:
influence a decision · 影响一项决定
have an influence on behavior · 对行为产生影响
ecdict-influence.usageNote: influence 作动词时直接接宾语；作名词时常用 an influence on。

ecdict-issue.example: The committee discussed several issues raised by students.
ecdict-issue.exampleZh: 委员会讨论了学生提出的几个问题。
ecdict-issue.collocationsText:
address an issue · 处理一个问题
raise an issue · 提出一个问题
ecdict-issue.usageNote: issue 表示待讨论或处理的问题时可数；raise an issue 是“提出问题”，address an issue 是“处理问题”。

ecdict-maintain.example: It is important to maintain a consistent temperature during the experiment.
ecdict-maintain.exampleZh: 在实验过程中保持温度稳定很重要。
ecdict-maintain.collocationsText:
maintain a balance · 保持平衡
maintain high standards · 维持高标准
ecdict-maintain.usageNote: maintain 可直接接宾语，表示使某种状态持续；不要在这一结构中加介词。

ecdict-method.example: The researchers compared two methods of collecting feedback.
ecdict-method.exampleZh: 研究人员比较了两种收集反馈的方法。
ecdict-method.collocationsText:
a research method · 研究方法
a method of analysis · 分析方法
ecdict-method.usageNote: 表示“做某事的方法”可用 a method of doing 或 a method for doing。

ecdict-participate.example: All students are encouraged to participate in the discussion.
ecdict-participate.exampleZh: 我们鼓励所有学生参与讨论。
ecdict-participate.collocationsText:
participate in a project · 参与一个项目
participate actively · 积极参与
ecdict-participate.usageNote: 表示“参加某项活动”时用 participate in；不要直接在 participate 后接活动名称。

ecdict-policy.example: The university introduced a new policy on the use of shared study rooms.
ecdict-policy.exampleZh: 大学推出了关于共用自习室使用的新规定。
ecdict-policy.collocationsText:
introduce a policy · 推出一项政策
a policy on attendance · 关于出勤的规定
ecdict-policy.usageNote: policy 表示具体的政策或规定时通常可数；on 或 about 可引出政策涉及的主题。

ecdict-principle.example: The course introduces the basic principles of experimental design.
ecdict-principle.exampleZh: 这门课程介绍实验设计的基本原则。
ecdict-principle.collocationsText:
a basic principle · 基本原则
apply a principle · 应用一项原则
ecdict-principle.usageNote: principle 表示“原则、原理”；principal 常表示“主要的”或“校长”，注意拼写区别。

ecdict-process.example: Revising a draft is an important part of the writing process.
ecdict-process.exampleZh: 修改初稿是写作过程中的一个重要环节。
ecdict-process.collocationsText:
the learning process · 学习过程
a gradual process · 渐进的过程
ecdict-process.usageNote: process 表示一连串步骤构成的“过程”；in the process of doing 表示“正在做某事”。

ecdict-publish.example: The journal will publish the results later this year.
ecdict-publish.exampleZh: 这本期刊将在今年晚些时候发表研究结果。
ecdict-publish.collocationsText:
publish an article · 发表一篇文章
publish the findings · 发表研究发现
ecdict-publish.usageNote: publish 表示“出版、发表”；论文“发表于某期刊”可用 be published in 加期刊名称。

ecdict-range.example: The library offers a wide range of books on environmental science.
ecdict-range.exampleZh: 图书馆提供种类丰富的环境科学书籍。
ecdict-range.collocationsText:
a wide range of topics · 广泛的话题
within the normal range · 在正常范围内
ecdict-range.usageNote: a range of 后常接复数名词，表示“一系列、多种”；range 也可指数值的范围。

ecdict-require.example: The assignment requires students to compare two different sources.
ecdict-require.exampleZh: 这项作业要求学生比较两个不同的资料来源。
ecdict-require.collocationsText:
require careful planning · 需要周密规划
require someone to explain · 要求某人解释
ecdict-require.usageNote: “要求某人做某事”用 require someone to do something；被动形式是 be required to do。

ecdict-research.example: The students carried out research on the history of their neighborhood.
ecdict-research.exampleZh: 学生们对所在社区的历史开展了研究。
ecdict-research.collocationsText:
carry out research · 开展研究
research into a topic · 对一个课题的研究
ecdict-research.usageNote: research 表示“研究”时通常不可数；一项具体研究可说 a study 或 a research project。

ecdict-resource.example: The online course provides useful resources for independent study.
ecdict-resource.exampleZh: 这门在线课程提供了适合自主学习的实用资源。
ecdict-resource.collocationsText:
learning resources · 学习资源
make use of resources · 利用资源
ecdict-resource.usageNote: resource 表示“资源”时可数；指多种材料、设备或其他可利用的条件时常用复数 resources。

ecdict-respond.example: The teacher asked us to respond to the author's main argument.
ecdict-respond.exampleZh: 老师要求我们回应作者的主要论点。
ecdict-respond.collocationsText:
respond to a question · 回答问题
respond positively · 积极回应
ecdict-respond.usageNote: respond to 后接回应的对象；to 是介词，可接名词或动名词。

ecdict-role.example: The article examines the role of libraries in local communities.
ecdict-role.exampleZh: 这篇文章探讨图书馆在当地社区中的作用。
ecdict-role.collocationsText:
play a role in education · 在教育中发挥作用
a central role · 核心作用
ecdict-role.usageNote: “在……中发挥作用”常用 play a role in；in 后可接名词或动名词。

ecdict-significant.example: The new reading room is a significant improvement on the old one.
ecdict-significant.exampleZh: 与旧阅览室相比，新的阅览室有了明显的改善。
ecdict-significant.collocationsText:
a significant change · 显著的变化
a significant contribution · 重要贡献
ecdict-significant.usageNote: significant 可表示“重要的、明显的”；统计学中的 statistically significant 有特定含义，不等同于实际影响很大。

ecdict-similar.example: The two articles reach similar conclusions using different evidence.
ecdict-similar.exampleZh: 这两篇文章使用不同的证据，得出了相似的结论。
ecdict-similar.collocationsText:
similar to an earlier study · 与先前的一项研究相似
similar results · 相似的结果
ecdict-similar.usageNote: “与……相似”用 similar to；similar 不表示完全相同。

ecdict-source.example: Check the original source before quoting a statistic.
ecdict-source.exampleZh: 引用统计数字之前，请核查原始来源。
ecdict-source.collocationsText:
a reliable source · 可靠来源
a source of information · 信息来源
ecdict-source.usageNote: source 表示信息等的“来源”时可数；a source of 后接所提供的信息或事物。

ecdict-specific.example: The feedback would be more useful if it included specific examples.
ecdict-specific.exampleZh: 如果反馈中包含具体的例子，就会更有帮助。
ecdict-specific.collocationsText:
a specific example · 具体的例子
specific requirements · 具体要求
ecdict-specific.usageNote: specific 强调“明确的、具体的”或“特定的”；be specific about 表示把某件事说清楚。

ecdict-structure.example: A clear structure makes an essay easier to follow.
ecdict-structure.exampleZh: 清晰的结构能让文章更容易理解。
ecdict-structure.collocationsText:
the structure of an essay · 文章的结构
a clear structure · 清晰的结构
ecdict-structure.usageNote: structure 在此指各部分的组织方式；作动词时可表示“组织、安排”。

ecdict-support.example: The examples support the author's claim about the value of practice.
ecdict-support.exampleZh: 这些例子支持了作者关于练习价值的观点。
ecdict-support.collocationsText:
support an argument · 支持一个论点
provide support for a claim · 为一个论断提供支持
ecdict-support.usageNote: support 作动词时直接接宾语；作名词时可用 support for。

ecdict-survey.example: The survey asked students how often they used the campus library.
ecdict-survey.exampleZh: 这项调查询问了学生使用校园图书馆的频率。
ecdict-survey.collocationsText:
conduct a survey · 开展调查
survey results · 调查结果
ecdict-survey.usageNote: survey 作名词表示“调查”时可数；a survey of students 指以学生为调查对象的调查。

ecdict-theory.example: The course links educational theory with classroom practice.
ecdict-theory.exampleZh: 这门课程将教育理论与课堂实践相结合。
ecdict-theory.collocationsText:
develop a theory · 建立一种理论
in theory · 理论上
ecdict-theory.usageNote: theory 泛指“理论”时常不可数，指某一种具体理论时可数；in theory 常与 in practice 相对。

ecdict-transfer.example: The students transferred their notes from paper to a shared document.
ecdict-transfer.exampleZh: 学生们把纸上的笔记转移到了一个共享文档中。
ecdict-transfer.collocationsText:
transfer information · 传递信息
transfer from one system to another · 从一个系统转移到另一个系统
ecdict-transfer.usageNote: “把某物从……转移到……”常用 transfer something from ... to ...；过去式为 transferred。

ecdict-abandon.example: After three failed attempts, we abandoned the plan to repair the old printer.
ecdict-abandon.exampleZh: 尝试三次都失败后，我们放弃了修理旧打印机的计划。
ecdict-abandon.collocationsText:
abandon a plan · 放弃计划
abandon an attempt · 放弃尝试
ecdict-abandon.usageNote: abandon 后直接接名词或动名词，表示彻底放弃某事；abandon doing something 中不要把 doing 改成 to do。

ecdict-absorb.example: The cloth absorbed the water before it reached the edge of the table.
ecdict-absorb.exampleZh: 水还没流到桌边就被布吸收了。
ecdict-absorb.collocationsText:
absorb moisture · 吸收水分
absorb information · 吸收信息
ecdict-absorb.usageNote: absorb 可指材料吸收液体，也可比喻理解、掌握信息；be absorbed in 表示“全神贯注于”。

ecdict-accessible.example: A ramp makes the reading room accessible to wheelchair users.
ecdict-accessible.exampleZh: 坡道让轮椅使用者能够进入阅览室。
ecdict-accessible.collocationsText:
accessible to everyone · 人人都能使用的
accessible information · 易于理解的信息
ecdict-accessible.usageNote: 常用 accessible to someone，表示某人能够进入、使用或理解；注意这里的 to 后接使用者或理解者。

ecdict-accommodate.example: The smaller classroom can accommodate twenty students comfortably.
ecdict-accommodate.exampleZh: 较小的那间教室可以宽松地容纳二十名学生。
ecdict-accommodate.collocationsText:
accommodate visitors · 接待来访者
accommodate different needs · 满足不同需求
ecdict-accommodate.usageNote: accommodate 是及物动词，后直接接宾语；既可指空间“容纳”，也可指安排上“照顾、满足”需求。注意拼写有两个 c 和两个 m。

ecdict-accomplish.example: By splitting the work into stages, we accomplished the task before lunch.
ecdict-accomplish.exampleZh: 我们把工作分成几个阶段，在午饭前完成了任务。
ecdict-accomplish.collocationsText:
accomplish a task · 完成任务
accomplish a goal · 实现目标
ecdict-accomplish.usageNote: accomplish 强调成功完成任务或实现目标，后接名词；表达“成功做成某事”也可用 succeed in doing something。

ecdict-accumulate.example: Unread messages accumulated while I was away from my desk.
ecdict-accumulate.exampleZh: 我离开办公桌期间，未读消息积了起来。
ecdict-accumulate.collocationsText:
accumulate experience · 积累经验
accumulate over time · 随时间积累
ecdict-accumulate.usageNote: accumulate 既可及物，也可不及物：accumulate experience 表示积累经验，dust accumulates 表示灰尘逐渐积聚。

ecdict-acknowledge.example: The report acknowledges that the sample is too small for a firm conclusion.
ecdict-acknowledge.exampleZh: 报告承认，样本过小，无法得出确定的结论。
ecdict-acknowledge.collocationsText:
acknowledge a mistake · 承认错误
acknowledge receipt · 确认收到
ecdict-acknowledge.usageNote: acknowledge 后可接名词、动名词或 that 从句；acknowledge receipt of… 常用于正式通知，表示确认收到某物。

ecdict-adjust.example: I adjusted the desk lamp so that the light fell on the page.
ecdict-adjust.exampleZh: 我调整了台灯，让光照在书页上。
ecdict-adjust.collocationsText:
adjust the settings · 调整设置
adjust to a new routine · 适应新的日常安排
ecdict-adjust.usageNote: adjust something 表示调整某物；adjust to something/doing something 表示适应，此处 to 是介词。

ecdict-advocate.example: The student group advocates making lecture recordings available to everyone.
ecdict-advocate.exampleZh: 这个学生团体提倡向所有人提供讲座录像。
ecdict-advocate.collocationsText:
advocate reform · 提倡改革
an advocate of equal access · 平等获取机会的倡导者
ecdict-advocate.usageNote: 作动词时常用 advocate doing something，不用 advocate to do；作可数名词时 an advocate of… 指某主张的支持者。

ecdict-affect.example: Background noise can affect how clearly a recording is heard.
ecdict-affect.exampleZh: 背景噪声会影响录音听起来是否清晰。
ecdict-affect.collocationsText:
affect performance · 影响表现
adversely affect something · 对某事产生不利影响
ecdict-affect.usageNote: affect 在这里是动词“影响”；effect 通常是名词“影响、效果”。可对照 affect the result 与 have an effect on the result。

ecdict-alternative.example: Cycling is a practical alternative to driving for this short journey.
ecdict-alternative.exampleZh: 这段路程很短，骑车是开车之外一个实用的选择。
ecdict-alternative.collocationsText:
an alternative to something · 某事物的替代选择
an alternative route · 另一条路线
ecdict-alternative.usageNote: 表示“……的替代选择”常用 an alternative to，to 后接名词或动名词。alternative 也可作形容词，修饰 route、method 等。

ecdict-ambiguous.example: The instruction was ambiguous, so two groups completed different tasks.
ecdict-ambiguous.exampleZh: 指令含糊不清，因此两个小组完成了不同的任务。
ecdict-ambiguous.collocationsText:
ambiguous wording · 含糊的措辞
an ambiguous statement · 模棱两可的说法
ecdict-ambiguous.usageNote: ambiguous 强调存在不止一种合理解释；vague 更常强调缺少细节或不够具体。名词是 ambiguity。

ecdict-anticipate.example: We anticipated a long queue and arrived before the doors opened.
ecdict-anticipate.exampleZh: 我们预料会排长队，所以在开门前就到了。
ecdict-anticipate.collocationsText:
anticipate a problem · 预料到问题
anticipate needing more time · 预料需要更多时间
ecdict-anticipate.usageNote: anticipate 后可接名词、动名词或 that 从句，通常不用 anticipate to do；它强调事先预见，而不一定表示期待好事。

ecdict-apparent.example: It became apparent that the two files contained different versions of the report.
ecdict-apparent.exampleZh: 后来很明显，两份文件包含的是报告的不同版本。
ecdict-apparent.collocationsText:
become apparent · 变得明显
an apparent contradiction · 表面上的矛盾
ecdict-apparent.usageNote: apparent 可指“明显的”，也可指“表面看来如此的”。It is apparent that… 通常强调明显；an apparent contradiction 可能只是表面矛盾。

ecdict-approach.example: As the train approached the station, passengers began collecting their bags.
ecdict-approach.exampleZh: 火车驶近车站时，乘客开始收拾行李。
ecdict-approach.collocationsText:
approach the entrance · 接近入口
approach someone for advice · 找某人征求建议
ecdict-approach.usageNote: 这里 approach 是及物动词“接近”，后直接接地点，不加 to；approach someone for something 可表示为某事找某人商量或求助。

ecdict-attribute.example: The team attributed the delay to a missing part rather than to poor planning.
ecdict-attribute.exampleZh: 团队把延误归因于缺少一个零件，而不是计划不周。
ecdict-attribute.collocationsText:
attribute success to effort · 把成功归因于努力
a key attribute · 一项关键特征
ecdict-attribute.usageNote: 作动词常用 attribute A to B，表示把 A 归因于 B；作名词时 attribute 是“特征、属性”，如 an attribute of the system。

ecdict-authority.example: Only the course coordinator has the authority to change the final deadline.
ecdict-authority.exampleZh: 只有课程协调员有权更改最终截止日期。
ecdict-authority.collocationsText:
have the authority to act · 有权采取行动
an authority on a subject · 某领域的权威
ecdict-authority.usageNote: 表示“权力、权限”时通常不可数；表示某领域的权威人士时可数，常用 an authority on…。the authorities 常指有关当局。

ecdict-available.example: A printed copy of the timetable is available at the front desk.
ecdict-available.exampleZh: 前台可以领取一份打印的时间表。
ecdict-available.collocationsText:
available to the public · 公众可获取的
readily available · 容易获得的
ecdict-available.usageNote: available 表示可获得或可使用；be available for a meeting 用于人时表示有空参会。修饰不定代词时放后面，如 something available。

ecdict-barrier.example: Clear signs can reduce the language barrier for visitors who are new to the city.
ecdict-barrier.exampleZh: 清晰的标识可以减轻初来这座城市的游客遇到的语言障碍。
ecdict-barrier.collocationsText:
a barrier to learning · 学习的障碍
remove a barrier · 消除障碍
ecdict-barrier.usageNote: 表示“……的障碍”常用 barrier to；这里 to 是介词，可接名词或动名词，如 a barrier to participating。

ecdict-balance.example: The timetable strikes a balance between focused study and regular breaks.
ecdict-balance.exampleZh: 这份时间表在专注学习与定时休息之间取得了平衡。
ecdict-balance.collocationsText:
strike a balance · 取得平衡
balance A against B · 权衡 A 与 B
ecdict-balance.usageNote: 常用 a balance between A and B；作动词时 balance A against B 强调权衡两方面的利弊或要求。

ecdict-characteristic.example: One characteristic of the course is its emphasis on practical experiments.
ecdict-characteristic.exampleZh: 这门课的一个特点是注重实验操作。
ecdict-characteristic.collocationsText:
a defining characteristic · 标志性特征
characteristic of something · 某事物特有的
ecdict-characteristic.usageNote: 作可数名词时指“特征”；作形容词时常用 be characteristic of，表示具有某人或某事物的典型特点。

ecdict-coherent.example: She rearranged the paragraphs to make the argument more coherent.
ecdict-coherent.exampleZh: 她重新安排了段落顺序，使论证更加连贯。
ecdict-coherent.collocationsText:
a coherent argument · 连贯的论证
a coherent account · 条理清楚的叙述
ecdict-coherent.usageNote: coherent 强调各部分逻辑上连贯、容易理解；它并不自动意味着论点正确或证据充分。副词是 coherently。

ecdict-commit.example: Each group committed to submitting a draft by Friday.
ecdict-commit.exampleZh: 每个小组都承诺在星期五前提交一份草稿。
ecdict-commit.collocationsText:
commit to a plan · 承诺执行计划
commit resources to a project · 为项目投入资源
ecdict-commit.usageNote: commit to 中的 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词；commit resources/time to… 表示将资源或时间投入某事。

ecdict-communicate.example: The diagram communicates the main idea without using technical terms.
ecdict-communicate.exampleZh: 这幅图不借助专业术语就传达了主要意思。
ecdict-communicate.collocationsText:
communicate with colleagues · 与同事沟通
communicate information to someone · 向某人传达信息
ecdict-communicate.usageNote: communicate with someone 强调与某人交流；communicate something to someone 强调把信息传达给某人。

ecdict-compensate.example: An extra practice session helped compensate for the lesson we missed.
ecdict-compensate.exampleZh: 一次额外练习帮助弥补了我们错过的那节课。
ecdict-compensate.collocationsText:
compensate for a loss · 弥补损失
compensate someone for damage · 补偿某人的损失
ecdict-compensate.usageNote: compensate for something 表示弥补某事；若说补偿某人，使用 compensate someone for something。for 后说明损失或不足。

ecdict-complement.example: The short videos complement the textbook by showing each experiment in action.
ecdict-complement.exampleZh: 这些短视频展示每个实验的实际过程，为教材提供补充。
ecdict-complement.collocationsText:
complement an existing service · 补充现有服务
a useful complement to something · 某事物的有益补充
ecdict-complement.usageNote: complement 指补充并使整体更完善；compliment 指赞美。作名词常用 a complement to，作动词直接接宾语。

ecdict-component.example: Listening practice is a central component of the weekly study plan.
ecdict-component.exampleZh: 听力练习是每周学习计划的核心组成部分。
ecdict-component.collocationsText:
a key component · 关键组成部分
a component of a system · 系统的一个组成部分
ecdict-component.usageNote: component 是可数名词，指构成整体的部分，常用 a component of…。它既可指实物零件，也可指计划或课程的组成内容。

ecdict-comprehensive.example: The guide provides a comprehensive overview of the museum's collections.
ecdict-comprehensive.exampleZh: 这份指南全面介绍了博物馆的藏品。
ecdict-comprehensive.collocationsText:
a comprehensive review · 全面的审查
comprehensive coverage · 全面覆盖
ecdict-comprehensive.usageNote: comprehensive 强调覆盖面广、内容全面；不要与 comprehensible 混淆，后者表示“能被理解的”。

ecdict-comprise.example: The training programme comprises four workshops and a final project.
ecdict-comprise.exampleZh: 培训项目包括四次工作坊和一个最终项目。
ecdict-comprise.collocationsText:
comprise several parts · 包含几个部分
comprise the majority · 占多数
ecdict-comprise.usageNote: 在“整体包含部分”的写法中，直接用 the programme comprises four workshops，不加 of；反向表达可用 four workshops make up the programme。

ecdict-confirm.example: The second measurement confirmed that the shelf was level.
ecdict-confirm.exampleZh: 第二次测量证实，架子是水平的。
ecdict-confirm.collocationsText:
confirm a booking · 确认预订
confirm that something is correct · 证实某事正确
ecdict-confirm.usageNote: confirm 后可直接接名词或 that 从句，不必加 about；可指核实事实，也可指确认预订等安排。

ecdict-conflict.example: The proposed meeting time conflicts with my afternoon class.
ecdict-conflict.exampleZh: 拟定的会议时间与我下午的课冲突。
ecdict-conflict.collocationsText:
conflict with a schedule · 与时间安排冲突
a conflict of interest · 利益冲突
ecdict-conflict.usageNote: 作动词常用 conflict with，表示相抵触或时间冲突；作名词可用 a conflict between A and B。引出相抵触的对象时用 with；也可说 Their schedules conflict。

ecdict-consent.example: The photographer asked for consent before taking pictures of the workshop participants.
ecdict-consent.exampleZh: 摄影师在拍摄工作坊参与者之前先征求了同意。
ecdict-consent.collocationsText:
give consent · 表示同意
consent to a proposal · 同意一项提议
ecdict-consent.usageNote: 作名词表示“同意、许可”时通常不可数，如 ask for consent；作动词用 consent to，to 后可接名词或动名词。

ecdict-constraint.example: Limited storage space was the main constraint on the design.
ecdict-constraint.exampleZh: 有限的储物空间是这一设计面临的主要限制。
ecdict-constraint.collocationsText:
time constraints · 时间限制
a constraint on development · 发展的制约因素
ecdict-constraint.usageNote: constraint 常作可数名词，复数 constraints 表示多种限制；常用 under constraints 或 a constraint on something。

ecdict-consult.example: Consult the index if you need to find a particular topic quickly.
ecdict-consult.exampleZh: 如果需要快速查找某个主题，请查阅索引。
ecdict-consult.collocationsText:
consult a reference book · 查阅参考书
consult someone about a problem · 就问题请教某人
ecdict-consult.usageNote: consult a book 指查阅书籍，consult a person 指请教某人；这两种用法都直接接宾语。consult with someone 则强调共同商议。

ecdict-consume.example: The old display consumed more electricity than the replacement.
ecdict-consume.exampleZh: 旧显示屏比替换后的显示屏耗电更多。
ecdict-consume.collocationsText:
consume energy · 消耗能源
consume resources · 消耗资源
ecdict-consume.usageNote: consume 在这里指“消耗”，直接接 energy、time、resources 等宾语；形容词 time-consuming 表示“耗时的”。

ecdict-contemporary.example: The historian compared two contemporary accounts of the storm.
ecdict-contemporary.exampleZh: 这位历史学家比较了两份在那场暴风雨发生的年代写成的记述。
ecdict-contemporary.collocationsText:
contemporary accounts · 同时代的记述
contemporary with an event · 与某事件同时期的
ecdict-contemporary.usageNote: 这里 contemporary 指与所述事件同一时代，不是现在的。be contemporary with… 表示“与……同时代”，理解时要找准时间参照。

ecdict-contradict.example: The figures in the appendix contradict the claim made in the introduction.
ecdict-contradict.exampleZh: 附录中的数字与引言中的说法相矛盾。
ecdict-contradict.collocationsText:
contradict the evidence · 与证据矛盾
contradict a statement · 反驳一种说法
ecdict-contradict.usageNote: contradict 是及物动词，后直接接宾语，不加 with；可指反驳某人，也可指两条信息互不相容。

ecdict-cooperate.example: The two libraries cooperated to make rare books easier to find.
ecdict-cooperate.exampleZh: 两家图书馆合作，让珍贵书籍更容易被检索到。
ecdict-cooperate.collocationsText:
cooperate with a partner · 与伙伴合作
cooperate on a project · 合作开展项目
ecdict-cooperate.usageNote: cooperate 是不及物动词，搭档用 with 引出，项目用 on 引出；可合用 cooperate with someone on something。

ecdict-coordinate.example: One volunteer coordinated the transport so that everyone arrived on time.
ecdict-coordinate.exampleZh: 一名志愿者协调了交通安排，让所有人都准时到达。
ecdict-coordinate.collocationsText:
coordinate activities · 协调活动
coordinate with another team · 与另一团队协调
ecdict-coordinate.usageNote: 这里 coordinate 作动词；coordinate something 指统筹某事，coordinate with someone 指与某人协调。名词 coordinator 指协调人员。

ecdict-crucial.example: Checking the units is crucial when comparing the two measurements.
ecdict-crucial.exampleZh: 比较这两个测量结果时，核对单位至关重要。
ecdict-crucial.collocationsText:
crucial to success · 对成功至关重要
a crucial factor · 关键因素
ecdict-crucial.usageNote: crucial 比 important 语气更强，常指对结果起关键作用；可用 be crucial to/for something，也可用 It is crucial to do something。

ecdict-deficit.example: The club covered its small budget deficit by reducing printing costs.
ecdict-deficit.exampleZh: 俱乐部通过减少印刷费用弥补了小额预算赤字。
ecdict-deficit.collocationsText:
a budget deficit · 预算赤字
reduce a deficit · 减少赤字
ecdict-deficit.usageNote: deficit 是可数名词，可指支出超过收入的赤字，也可指数量不足；财务语境中与 surplus（盈余）相对。

ecdict-deliberate.example: Leaving the final page blank was a deliberate choice, not a printing error.
ecdict-deliberate.exampleZh: 最后一页留白是有意的安排，并非印刷错误。
ecdict-deliberate.collocationsText:
a deliberate decision · 经过考虑的决定
a deliberate attempt · 有意的尝试
ecdict-deliberate.usageNote: 这里 deliberate 是形容词“有意的、经过考虑的”，常与 accidental（意外的）形成对照；作动词时可表示仔细考虑。

ecdict-diminish.example: The noise diminished as we moved farther from the road.
ecdict-diminish.exampleZh: 随着我们离公路越来越远，噪声减弱了。
ecdict-diminish.collocationsText:
diminish in importance · 重要性下降
diminish the impact · 减小影响
ecdict-diminish.usageNote: diminish 既可不及物，表示自身减少，也可及物，表示使某物减少；通常强调程度或数量下降，并不等于完全消失。

ecdict-distinct.example: The interviews revealed three distinct reasons for joining the course.
ecdict-distinct.exampleZh: 访谈显示，大家参加这门课程有三种不同的原因。
ecdict-distinct.collocationsText:
distinct from something · 与某事物不同的
a distinct advantage · 明显的优势
ecdict-distinct.usageNote: distinct 可指“不同的”或“明显的”；distinct from 表示区分两者。distinctive 更强调有辨识度、能使人认出的特色。

ecdict-dominant.example: A single large window is the dominant feature of the room.
ecdict-dominant.exampleZh: 一扇大窗户是这间房间最突出的特色。
ecdict-dominant.collocationsText:
a dominant position · 主导地位
a dominant role · 主导作用
ecdict-dominant.usageNote: dominant 表示居于优势或起主导作用，不必然表示唯一；相关动词 dominate 表示支配或占主要地位。

ecdict-duration.example: Please keep your phone silent for the duration of the performance.
ecdict-duration.exampleZh: 请在演出全程保持手机静音。
ecdict-duration.collocationsText:
the duration of a course · 课程的持续时间
for the duration of something · 在某事的整个期间
ecdict-duration.usageNote: duration 指一件事持续的时间长度；for the duration of… 表示贯穿整个期间。不要与表示截止时间的 deadline 混淆。

ecdict-dynamic.example: The map is dynamic, updating whenever a new observation is added.
ecdict-dynamic.exampleZh: 这幅地图会动态更新，每增加一条新观测记录就会变化。
ecdict-dynamic.collocationsText:
a dynamic process · 不断变化的过程
a dynamic environment · 不断变化的环境
ecdict-dynamic.usageNote: 这里 dynamic 表示会变化、会更新，与 static（静态的）相对；修饰人时也可表示有活力、有干劲。

ecdict-eliminate.example: A checklist helps eliminate simple errors before the report is submitted.
ecdict-eliminate.exampleZh: 检查清单有助于在提交报告前消除简单错误。
ecdict-eliminate.collocationsText:
eliminate an error · 消除错误
eliminate the need for something · 使某事不再必要
ecdict-eliminate.usageNote: eliminate 通常强调去除或排除，比 reduce（减少）语气更强；eliminate something from something 表示从某处去除某物。

ecdict-empirical.example: The team wanted empirical evidence before accepting the proposed explanation.
ecdict-empirical.exampleZh: 团队希望获得基于观察或实验的证据，再接受所提出的解释。
ecdict-empirical.collocationsText:
empirical evidence · 实证证据
empirical research · 实证研究
ecdict-empirical.usageNote: 学术语境中 empirical 强调依据观察或实验所得的证据，而不只是理论推导；它并不等于“未经检验的个人感觉”。

ecdict-essential.example: A clear research question is essential for keeping the project focused.
ecdict-essential.exampleZh: 明确的研究问题对于让项目保持重点至关重要。
ecdict-essential.collocationsText:
essential for success · 成功所必需的
an essential component · 必不可少的组成部分
ecdict-essential.usageNote: essential 常指必不可少，可用 essential for/to something；句型 It is essential to do something 表示做某事很必要。

ecdict-exclude.example: The price shown excludes the cost of delivery.
ecdict-exclude.exampleZh: 标示的价格不包括配送费用。
ecdict-exclude.collocationsText:
exclude something from a total · 从总额中排除某项
exclude the possibility · 排除某种可能性
ecdict-exclude.usageNote: exclude 与 include 相对；exclude A from B 表示不把 A 纳入 B。价格说明中的 excluding delivery 表示不含配送费。

ecdict-expand.example: Could you expand on the final point in your presentation?
ecdict-expand.exampleZh: 你能进一步说明演示中的最后一点吗？
ecdict-expand.collocationsText:
expand on an idea · 进一步阐述一个想法
expand into a new market · 拓展到新市场
ecdict-expand.usageNote: expand on/upon something 表示进一步详述；expand 直接接宾语或单独使用时，也可指扩大规模或范围。

ecdict-explicit.example: The instructions were explicit about which pages we needed to read.
ecdict-explicit.exampleZh: 指令明确说明了我们需要阅读哪些页面。
ecdict-explicit.collocationsText:
explicit instructions · 明确的指示
make something explicit · 把某事说清楚
ecdict-explicit.usageNote: explicit 强调直接、清楚地表达；implicit 表示未直接说出但可推知的。be explicit about… 表示就某事说得明确。

ecdict-external.example: The project received feedback from an external reviewer.
ecdict-external.exampleZh: 项目收到了来自一位外部评审者的反馈。
ecdict-external.collocationsText:
external factors · 外部因素
an external source · 外部来源
ecdict-external.usageNote: external 表示组织、系统或物体之外的，与 internal 相对；它不等于 foreign，不必涉及其他国家。

ecdict-facilitate.example: A shared calendar facilitates communication between the two teams.
ecdict-facilitate.exampleZh: 共享日历使两个团队之间的沟通更加方便。
ecdict-facilitate.collocationsText:
facilitate learning · 促进学习
facilitate cooperation · 促进合作
ecdict-facilitate.usageNote: facilitate 是及物动词，后接活动、过程等名词或动名词；通常不用 facilitate someone to do。它表示使过程更容易，不保证结果一定实现。

ecdict-feasible.example: We need to decide whether a weekend workshop is feasible within the budget.
ecdict-feasible.exampleZh: 我们需要确定，在现有预算内举办周末工作坊是否可行。
ecdict-feasible.collocationsText:
a feasible solution · 可行的解决方案
financially feasible · 在财务上可行的
ecdict-feasible.usageNote: feasible 强调在实际条件下能够做到；desirable 强调值得做，两者并不相同。常用 It is feasible to do something。

ecdict-flexible.example: The course has a flexible schedule for students who work during the day.
ecdict-flexible.exampleZh: 这门课提供灵活的时间安排，方便白天工作的学生。
ecdict-flexible.collocationsText:
a flexible schedule · 灵活的时间安排
be flexible about arrangements · 在安排上灵活变通
ecdict-flexible.usageNote: flexible 在这里表示安排可调整；形容材料时也可指容易弯曲。名词 flexibility 可表示灵活性或柔韧性。

ecdict-fundamental.example: Trust is fundamental to a successful partnership.
ecdict-fundamental.exampleZh: 信任是成功合作关系的基础。
ecdict-fundamental.collocationsText:
fundamental to something · 对某事至关重要的
a fundamental difference · 根本区别
ecdict-fundamental.usageNote: fundamental 强调基础性或根本性，常用 fundamental to；复数名词 the fundamentals 指某领域的基本原理或基础知识。

ecdict-generate.example: The discussion generated several ideas for improving the library.
ecdict-generate.exampleZh: 讨论产生了几个改善图书馆的想法。
ecdict-generate.collocationsText:
generate interest · 引起兴趣
generate electricity · 发电
ecdict-generate.usageNote: generate 是及物动词，可指产生想法、兴趣、收入或电力，后直接接宾语；如需交代来源，可在宾语后用 from 引出。

ecdict-implement.example: The library will implement the new borrowing system at the start of the term.
ecdict-implement.exampleZh: 图书馆将在学期开始时实施新的借阅系统。
ecdict-implement.collocationsText:
implement a policy · 实施政策
implement a plan · 执行计划
ecdict-implement.usageNote: 这里 implement 作动词，指把已经决定的计划、政策或系统付诸实施；名词 implementation 指实施过程。

ecdict-education.example: The city is investing in education to give more children a strong start.
ecdict-education.exampleZh: 这座城市正在投资教育，让更多孩子拥有良好的起点。
ecdict-education.collocationsText:
higher education · 高等教育
access to education · 受教育的机会
ecdict-education.usageNote: education 表示教育这一过程或领域时通常不可数；接受教育可说 receive an education。

ecdict-knowledge.example: She used her knowledge of biology to explain how the plants grow.
ecdict-knowledge.exampleZh: 她运用自己的生物学知识来解释植物如何生长。
ecdict-knowledge.collocationsText:
practical knowledge · 实用知识
knowledge of a subject · 某一学科的知识
ecdict-knowledge.usageNote: knowledge 通常不可数，不用 knowledges 表示知识；表示对某领域的了解可用 knowledge of 或 a knowledge of。

ecdict-skill.example: The course helps students develop the skills they need to work in a team.
ecdict-skill.exampleZh: 这门课程帮助学生培养团队合作所需的技能。
ecdict-skill.collocationsText:
develop a skill · 培养一项技能
communication skills · 沟通技能
ecdict-skill.usageNote: skill 指某项具体技能时可数；表示做某事的熟练程度时也可不可数，如 with great skill。

ecdict-course.example: I signed up for a course in environmental science this term.
ecdict-course.exampleZh: 这学期我报名参加了一门环境科学课程。
ecdict-course.collocationsText:
take a course · 修读一门课程
an online course · 一门在线课程
ecdict-course.usageNote: course 在这里是可数名词，指一系列课程或一门课；一节课通常用 lesson 或 class。

ecdict-lecture.example: After the lecture, several students stayed to ask the speaker questions.
ecdict-lecture.exampleZh: 讲座结束后，几名学生留下来向主讲人提问。
ecdict-lecture.collocationsText:
attend a lecture · 听讲座
give a lecture · 作讲座
ecdict-lecture.usageNote: lecture on 后接讲座主题；give someone a lecture 还可能表示训斥某人，要根据语境判断。

ecdict-assignment.example: Our first assignment is to compare two articles on the same topic.
ecdict-assignment.exampleZh: 我们的第一项作业是比较两篇关于同一主题的文章。
ecdict-assignment.collocationsText:
complete an assignment · 完成一项作业
a written assignment · 一份书面作业
ecdict-assignment.usageNote: assignment 指分配的具体作业或任务，是可数名词；homework 通常不可数。

ecdict-examination.example: Students may bring a dictionary into the final examination.
ecdict-examination.exampleZh: 学生可以携带词典参加期末考试。
ecdict-examination.collocationsText:
take an examination · 参加考试
pass an examination · 通过考试
ecdict-examination.usageNote: examination 表示考试时可数，exam 是常用缩略形式；take 强调参加，pass 强调通过。

ecdict-degree.example: She completed a degree in engineering before joining the company.
ecdict-degree.exampleZh: 加入这家公司之前，她完成了工程学学位课程。
ecdict-degree.collocationsText:
a university degree · 大学学位
a degree in engineering · 工程学学位
ecdict-degree.usageNote: degree in 后接学科；表示学士学位常说 a bachelor's degree，注意所有格形式。

ecdict-academic.example: The library gives students access to a wide range of academic journals.
ecdict-academic.exampleZh: 图书馆为学生提供了查阅多种学术期刊的机会。
ecdict-academic.collocationsText:
academic research · 学术研究
academic performance · 学业表现
ecdict-academic.usageNote: academic 在这里是形容词；修饰研究、期刊时常译为学术的，修饰表现时常与学业有关。

ecdict-curriculum.example: The school added basic programming to its curriculum.
ecdict-curriculum.exampleZh: 学校在课程体系中加入了基础编程。
ecdict-curriculum.collocationsText:
the school curriculum · 学校课程体系
develop a curriculum · 制订课程体系
ecdict-curriculum.usageNote: curriculum 通常指学校或专业的整体课程安排，不是一节课；复数可用 curricula 或 curriculums。

ecdict-tuition.example: The scholarship covers tuition but does not pay for accommodation.
ecdict-tuition.exampleZh: 这项奖学金支付学费，但不支付住宿费。
ecdict-tuition.collocationsText:
tuition fees · 学费
pay tuition · 缴纳学费
ecdict-tuition.usageNote: tuition 通常不可数，在美式英语中常指学费；英式英语中也常指教学或辅导。

ecdict-scholarship.example: He received a scholarship to study chemistry at university.
ecdict-scholarship.exampleZh: 他获得了一笔到大学学习化学的奖学金。
ecdict-scholarship.collocationsText:
win a scholarship · 获得奖学金
apply for a scholarship · 申请奖学金
ecdict-scholarship.usageNote: scholarship 表示奖学金时可数；apply for 表示申请，不表示已经获得。

ecdict-experiment.example: The students repeated the experiment to check whether the results were consistent.
ecdict-experiment.exampleZh: 学生们重复了这个实验，以检查结果是否一致。
ecdict-experiment.collocationsText:
conduct an experiment · 进行实验
an experiment on plant growth · 一项关于植物生长的实验
ecdict-experiment.usageNote: experiment 作名词表示具体实验时可数；作动词表示尝试某种方法时常用 experiment with。

ecdict-scientific.example: The report explains the scientific principles behind the new battery.
ecdict-scientific.exampleZh: 这份报告解释了这种新型电池背后的科学原理。
ecdict-scientific.collocationsText:
scientific evidence · 科学证据
scientific research · 科学研究
ecdict-scientific.usageNote: scientific 是形容词，science 是名词；修饰研究的方法或过程时，副词形式为 scientifically。

ecdict-technology.example: The farm uses new technology to monitor how much water the crops need.
ecdict-technology.exampleZh: 这家农场使用新技术来监测农作物需要多少水。
ecdict-technology.collocationsText:
modern technology · 现代技术
develop new technology · 开发新技术
ecdict-technology.usageNote: technology 泛指技术时通常不可数；technologies 可指多种具体技术。

ecdict-equipment.example: Check that all the equipment is working before the experiment begins.
ecdict-equipment.exampleZh: 实验开始前，要检查所有设备是否都能正常运转。
ecdict-equipment.collocationsText:
laboratory equipment · 实验室设备
a piece of equipment · 一件设备
ecdict-equipment.usageNote: equipment 不可数，不加复数 s；all the equipment 作主语时通常用单数谓语。

ecdict-laboratory.example: The samples were sent to a laboratory for further testing.
ecdict-laboratory.exampleZh: 样本被送往实验室进行进一步检测。
ecdict-laboratory.collocationsText:
a research laboratory · 研究实验室
laboratory tests · 实验室检测
ecdict-laboratory.usageNote: laboratory 是可数名词，lab 是常用简称；在实验室里通常用 in a laboratory。

ecdict-measurement.example: We took three measurements of the table and recorded the average length.
ecdict-measurement.exampleZh: 我们测量了三次桌子，并记录了平均长度。
ecdict-measurement.collocationsText:
take a measurement · 进行一次测量
accurate measurements · 精确的测量结果
ecdict-measurement.usageNote: measurement 可指测量过程，也可指测得的数值；take measurements 是常见搭配。

ecdict-observation.example: Careful observation revealed small changes in the colour of the leaves.
ecdict-observation.exampleZh: 仔细观察发现了叶片颜色的细微变化。
ecdict-observation.collocationsText:
careful observation · 仔细观察
direct observation · 直接观察
ecdict-observation.usageNote: observation 指观察过程时通常不可数；an observation 可指一次观察或一条观察所得的评论。

ecdict-discovery.example: The discovery of a new material changed the direction of the research.
ecdict-discovery.exampleZh: 一种新材料的发现改变了这项研究的方向。
ecdict-discovery.collocationsText:
make a discovery · 作出发现
a scientific discovery · 一项科学发现
ecdict-discovery.usageNote: discovery 常与 make 搭配；发现原本存在的事物用 discovery，创造新的事物通常用 invention。

ecdict-chemical.example: Students learned how temperature affects the speed of a chemical reaction.
ecdict-chemical.exampleZh: 学生们学习了温度如何影响化学反应的速度。
ecdict-chemical.collocationsText:
a chemical reaction · 化学反应
chemical properties · 化学性质
ecdict-chemical.usageNote: chemical 在例句中是形容词；作可数名词时表示化学品，复数为 chemicals。

ecdict-temperature.example: The temperature of the water rose slowly during the experiment.
ecdict-temperature.exampleZh: 实验过程中，水温缓慢上升。
ecdict-temperature.collocationsText:
room temperature · 室温
a rise in temperature · 温度上升
ecdict-temperature.usageNote: 温度高低常用 high 和 low；升高、降低分别可用 rise 和 fall。

ecdict-energy.example: The new windows help the building use less energy in winter.
ecdict-energy.exampleZh: 新窗户有助于这栋建筑在冬季减少能源消耗。
ecdict-energy.collocationsText:
save energy · 节约能源
renewable energy · 可再生能源
ecdict-energy.usageNote: energy 表示能源或能量时通常不可数，所以用 less energy，不用 fewer energy。

ecdict-substance.example: The laboratory checks whether the water contains any harmful substances.
ecdict-substance.exampleZh: 实验室检查水中是否含有任何有害物质。
ecdict-substance.collocationsText:
a harmful substance · 有害物质
a chemical substance · 化学物质
ecdict-substance.usageNote: substance 指某一种物质时可数；the substance of a report 中则指报告的实质或主要内容。

ecdict-income.example: The family spends about a third of its monthly income on rent.
ecdict-income.exampleZh: 这个家庭每月收入的约三分之一用于支付房租。
ecdict-income.collocationsText:
monthly income · 月收入
a source of income · 收入来源
ecdict-income.usageNote: income 指收入，不等于 profit（扣除成本后的利润）；描述收入水平常用 high 或 low。

ecdict-investment.example: The company plans to increase its investment in staff training.
ecdict-investment.exampleZh: 公司计划增加在员工培训方面的投入。
ecdict-investment.collocationsText:
investment in education · 对教育的投入
long-term investment · 长期投资
ecdict-investment.usageNote: 投入某一领域常用 investment in；表示一次具体投资时可说 an investment。

ecdict-employment.example: The new factory is expected to create employment in the region.
ecdict-employment.exampleZh: 预计这家新工厂将为该地区创造就业机会。
ecdict-employment.collocationsText:
full-time employment · 全职工作
employment opportunities · 就业机会
ecdict-employment.usageNote: employment 表示就业或雇用状态时通常不可数；一份具体工作通常用 a job。

ecdict-industry.example: The tourism industry provides work for many people in the town.
ecdict-industry.exampleZh: 旅游业为镇上的许多人提供了工作。
ecdict-industry.collocationsText:
the tourism industry · 旅游业
local industry · 当地工业
ecdict-industry.usageNote: industry 泛指工业时通常不可数；指某个行业时可数，如 the food industry。

ecdict-production.example: The factory reduced production because fewer customers were placing orders.
ecdict-production.exampleZh: 由于下单的客户减少了，这家工厂降低了产量。
ecdict-production.collocationsText:
increase production · 增加产量
mass production · 大规模生产
ecdict-production.usageNote: production 表示生产活动或产量时通常不可数；product 是生产出来的产品。

ecdict-consumer.example: Consumers can compare prices online before deciding what to buy.
ecdict-consumer.exampleZh: 消费者可以先在网上比较价格，再决定买什么。
ecdict-consumer.collocationsText:
consumer demand · 消费者需求
consumer protection · 消费者保护
ecdict-consumer.usageNote: consumer 强调使用商品或服务的人；customer 强调向某家商店或企业购买的顾客。

ecdict-demand.example: Demand for public transport tends to rise when fuel becomes more expensive.
ecdict-demand.exampleZh: 燃料价格上涨时，对公共交通的需求往往会增加。
ecdict-demand.collocationsText:
demand for a product · 对一种产品的需求
meet demand · 满足需求
ecdict-demand.usageNote: 表示对某物的需求用 demand for；demand 作动词时直接接宾语，如 demand an explanation。

ecdict-supply.example: The storm interrupted the supply of electricity to several villages.
ecdict-supply.exampleZh: 暴风雨中断了几个村庄的电力供应。
ecdict-supply.collocationsText:
water supply · 供水
supply and demand · 供给与需求
ecdict-supply.usageNote: supply 作动词可用 supply someone with something，也可用 supply something to someone。

ecdict-profit.example: The shop made a small profit after paying all its operating costs.
ecdict-profit.exampleZh: 支付全部运营成本后，这家商店获得了少量利润。
ecdict-profit.collocationsText:
make a profit · 获利
net profit · 净利润
ecdict-profit.usageNote: profit 指收入扣除成本后的利润；make a profit 与 make a loss 分别表示盈利和亏损。

ecdict-revenue.example: The museum uses revenue from ticket sales to maintain its buildings.
ecdict-revenue.exampleZh: 博物馆用门票销售收入来维护馆舍。
ecdict-revenue.collocationsText:
annual revenue · 年收入
generate revenue · 带来收入
ecdict-revenue.usageNote: revenue 通常指尚未扣除成本的收入，不等于 profit；来源常用 revenue from 表达。

ecdict-budget.example: We revised the budget after the cost of materials increased.
ecdict-budget.exampleZh: 材料成本上涨后，我们修改了预算。
ecdict-budget.collocationsText:
set a budget · 制订预算
stay within budget · 控制在预算以内
ecdict-budget.usageNote: within budget 表示未超预算，over budget 表示超出预算；budget 也可作动词，表示安排开支。

ecdict-inflation.example: High inflation makes it harder for households to plan their spending.
ecdict-inflation.exampleZh: 高通胀让家庭更难规划开支。
ecdict-inflation.collocationsText:
the rate of inflation · 通货膨胀率
control inflation · 控制通货膨胀
ecdict-inflation.usageNote: inflation 表示通货膨胀时不可数；它通常指总体物价水平上涨，不是某一种商品单独涨价。

ecdict-career.example: She began her career as a teacher before moving into educational research.
ecdict-career.exampleZh: 她最初从事教师工作，后来转向教育研究。
ecdict-career.collocationsText:
pursue a career · 从事某项事业
career development · 职业发展
ecdict-career.usageNote: career 通常指较长时期的职业经历或发展；job 更常指某一份具体工作。

ecdict-colleague.example: I asked a colleague to check the report before I sent it to our manager.
ecdict-colleague.exampleZh: 把报告发给经理之前，我请一位同事检查了一遍。
ecdict-colleague.collocationsText:
a former colleague · 以前的同事
work with colleagues · 与同事共事
ecdict-colleague.usageNote: colleague 是可数名词，指一起工作的人，不必与自己担任同一职位。

ecdict-responsibility.example: Each team member has responsibility for a different part of the project.
ecdict-responsibility.exampleZh: 每名团队成员负责项目的不同部分。
ecdict-responsibility.collocationsText:
take responsibility for · 对……负责
shared responsibility · 共同责任
ecdict-responsibility.usageNote: 负责某事用 responsibility for；具体职责可用复数 responsibilities。

ecdict-deadline.example: We agreed to extend the deadline so the team could check the figures.
ecdict-deadline.exampleZh: 我们同意延长截止期限，让团队有时间核对数据。
ecdict-deadline.collocationsText:
meet a deadline · 按期完成
miss a deadline · 未能按期完成
ecdict-deadline.usageNote: by the deadline 表示最迟在截止时间完成；meet a deadline 不表示与某人见面。

ecdict-task.example: Breaking a large task into smaller steps makes it easier to get started.
ecdict-task.exampleZh: 把一项大任务分成较小的步骤，会让人更容易着手去做。
ecdict-task.collocationsText:
complete a task · 完成任务
assign a task · 分配任务
ecdict-task.usageNote: task 是可数名词，指一项具体任务；泛指工作时，work 通常不可数。

ecdict-project.example: The team is working on a project to improve the library's booking system.
ecdict-project.exampleZh: 团队正在开展一个改进图书馆预约系统的项目。
ecdict-project.collocationsText:
manage a project · 管理项目
work on a project · 开展项目工作
ecdict-project.usageNote: project 在这里是可数名词；开展某个项目用 work on a project，而不是 work a project。

ecdict-interview.example: During the interview, she explained how she had solved a problem at work.
ecdict-interview.exampleZh: 面试中，她讲述了自己如何解决工作中的一个问题。
ecdict-interview.collocationsText:
a job interview · 求职面试
prepare for an interview · 准备面试
ecdict-interview.usageNote: interview 可作名词或动词；interview someone 是面试某人，be interviewed 是接受面试。

ecdict-training.example: All new staff receive training before they use the equipment.
ecdict-training.exampleZh: 所有新员工在使用设备前都要接受培训。
ecdict-training.collocationsText:
staff training · 员工培训
a training course · 培训课程
ecdict-training.usageNote: training 通常不可数；指一次具体培训活动，可用 a training session。

ecdict-qualification.example: The job requires a teaching qualification and at least two years of experience.
ecdict-qualification.exampleZh: 这份工作要求具备教学资格和至少两年的经验。
ecdict-qualification.collocationsText:
a professional qualification · 专业资格
gain a qualification · 获得资格
ecdict-qualification.usageNote: qualification 表示某项资格时可数；qualifications 常统称学历、资质等任职条件。

ecdict-salary.example: The advertisement lists the annual salary and the number of working hours.
ecdict-salary.exampleZh: 招聘广告列出了年薪和工作时数。
ecdict-salary.collocationsText:
an annual salary · 年薪
a salary increase · 加薪
ecdict-salary.usageNote: salary 通常指按月等固定周期发放的薪水；annual salary 指全年薪酬金额。

ecdict-profession.example: Teaching is a profession that requires patience and clear communication.
ecdict-profession.exampleZh: 教学是一种需要耐心和清晰沟通能力的职业。
ecdict-profession.collocationsText:
enter a profession · 进入某一职业领域
the teaching profession · 教育行业
ecdict-profession.usageNote: profession 常指需要专门教育或训练的职业；professional 可作形容词，表示专业的。

ecdict-experience.example: The placement gave her practical experience of working with customers.
ecdict-experience.exampleZh: 这次实习让她获得了与客户打交道的实践经验。
ecdict-experience.collocationsText:
work experience · 工作经验
gain experience · 积累经验
ecdict-experience.usageNote: experience 表示经验时不可数；表示一次具体经历时可数，如 an interesting experience。

ecdict-pollution.example: The city is planting trees and improving public transport to reduce air pollution.
ecdict-pollution.exampleZh: 这座城市正在植树并改善公共交通，以减少空气污染。
ecdict-pollution.collocationsText:
air pollution · 空气污染
reduce pollution · 减少污染
ecdict-pollution.usageNote: pollution 通常不可数；pollute 是动词，pollutant 是指污染物的可数名词。

ecdict-climate.example: The region's warm climate allows farmers to grow fruit for much of the year.
ecdict-climate.exampleZh: 这个地区气候温暖，农民一年中有很长一段时间都能种植水果。
ecdict-climate.collocationsText:
climate change · 气候变化
a mild climate · 温和的气候
ecdict-climate.usageNote: climate 指一个地区长期的气候特征；weather 指某时某地较短期的天气状况。

ecdict-reduce.example: Repairing old furniture can reduce the amount of waste sent to landfill.
ecdict-reduce.exampleZh: 修理旧家具可以减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物量。
ecdict-reduce.collocationsText:
reduce waste · 减少废物
reduce energy use · 减少能源使用
ecdict-reduce.usageNote: reduce by 后接减少的幅度，reduce to 后接减少后的数值，二者含义不同。

ecdict-waste.example: The school separates food waste from paper and plastic.
ecdict-waste.exampleZh: 学校将厨余垃圾与纸张和塑料分开处理。
ecdict-waste.collocationsText:
food waste · 厨余垃圾
household waste · 生活垃圾
ecdict-waste.usageNote: waste 表示废物时通常不可数；作动词表示浪费，常用 waste time doing something。

ecdict-recycle.example: Residents can recycle glass bottles at the collection point near the station.
ecdict-recycle.exampleZh: 居民可以在车站附近的收集点回收玻璃瓶。
ecdict-recycle.collocationsText:
recycle paper · 回收利用纸张
recycle materials · 回收利用材料
ecdict-recycle.usageNote: recycle 是动词；recyclable 表示可回收的，recycled 表示已用回收材料制成的或已回收的。

ecdict-conservation.example: The park runs conservation projects to protect local wildlife.
ecdict-conservation.exampleZh: 这座公园开展保护项目，以保护当地野生生物。
ecdict-conservation.collocationsText:
wildlife conservation · 野生生物保护
energy conservation · 节能
ecdict-conservation.usageNote: conservation 通常不可数；可指保护自然环境，也可指节约能源等资源。

ecdict-habitat.example: Building new roads can divide the natural habitat of wild animals.
ecdict-habitat.exampleZh: 修建新道路可能会割裂野生动物的自然栖息地。
ecdict-habitat.collocationsText:
natural habitat · 自然栖息地
habitat loss · 栖息地丧失
ecdict-habitat.usageNote: habitat 指动植物自然生活的环境，是可数名词；不要与 habit（习惯）混淆。

ecdict-species.example: Several species of birds return to the wetland every spring.
ecdict-species.exampleZh: 每年春天，几种鸟类都会返回这片湿地。
ecdict-species.collocationsText:
an endangered species · 一种濒危物种
different species · 不同物种
ecdict-species.usageNote: species 单复数同形：one species is，several species are；不能根据末尾 s 判断单复数。

ecdict-forest.example: The path leads through a forest before reaching the lake.
ecdict-forest.exampleZh: 这条小路穿过一片森林，然后到达湖边。
ecdict-forest.collocationsText:
a tropical forest · 热带森林
protect forests · 保护森林
ecdict-forest.usageNote: forest 表示一片森林时可数；forestry 指林业，通常不可数。

ecdict-soil.example: Adding compost can help the soil retain water during dry weather.
ecdict-soil.exampleZh: 添加堆肥有助于土壤在干燥天气中保持水分。
ecdict-soil.collocationsText:
fertile soil · 肥沃的土壤
soil erosion · 土壤侵蚀
ecdict-soil.usageNote: soil 泛指土壤时通常不可数；soils 可以表示不同类型的土壤。

ecdict-agriculture.example: Agriculture depends on reliable access to water and healthy soil.
ecdict-agriculture.exampleZh: 农业依赖稳定的水源和健康的土壤。
ecdict-agriculture.collocationsText:
modern agriculture · 现代农业
sustainable agriculture · 可持续农业
ecdict-agriculture.usageNote: agriculture 是不可数名词，泛指农业时通常不加冠词；对应的形容词是 agricultural，如 agricultural production（农业生产）。

ecdict-protect.example: Fences help protect young trees from damage by grazing animals.
ecdict-protect.exampleZh: 围栏有助于保护幼树，使其免遭食草动物破坏。
ecdict-protect.collocationsText:
protect the environment · 保护环境
protect against damage · 防止损害
ecdict-protect.usageNote: protect someone or something from/against 后接危险或伤害；protection 是对应的名词。

ecdict-achieve.example: The team achieved better results after simplifying the instructions.
ecdict-achieve.exampleZh: 简化说明后，团队取得了更好的结果。
ecdict-achieve.collocationsText:
achieve success · 取得成功
achieve a balance · 实现平衡
ecdict-achieve.usageNote: achieve 后直接接目标或成果，不用 achieve to；achievement 是名词，表示“成就”。

ecdict-analysis.example: Our analysis of the interviews revealed three recurring concerns.
ecdict-analysis.exampleZh: 我们对访谈的分析发现了三个反复出现的担忧。
ecdict-analysis.collocationsText:
data analysis · 数据分析
comparative analysis · 比较分析
ecdict-analysis.usageNote: analysis 是名词，复数为 analyses；analyze 是动词，英式拼写也可用 analyse。

ecdict-apply.example: Students applied the formula to a problem involving two moving trains.
ecdict-apply.exampleZh: 学生们把这个公式应用于一道涉及两列行驶中火车的题目。
ecdict-apply.collocationsText:
apply a method · 应用一种方法
apply for funding · 申请资助
ecdict-apply.usageNote: apply A to B 表示“把 A 应用于 B”；apply for 表示“申请”职位、资助等。

ecdict-argue.example: The author argues that convenient bus services can reduce car use.
ecdict-argue.exampleZh: 作者主张，便捷的公交服务可以减少汽车的使用。
ecdict-argue.collocationsText:
argue for reform · 提出理由支持改革
argue against a proposal · 提出理由反对一项提议
ecdict-argue.usageNote: argue that 后接主张的内容；argue for/against 表示“提出理由支持／反对”，不一定指争吵。

ecdict-associate.example: Many visitors associate the city with its riverside markets.
ecdict-associate.exampleZh: 许多游客一提到这座城市就会联想到河畔市场。
ecdict-associate.collocationsText:
associate a smell with a memory · 把一种气味与一段记忆联系起来
be associated with · 与……有关
ecdict-associate.usageNote: associate A with B 表示“把 A 与 B 联系起来”；be associated with 表示“与……有关”，本身不等于因果关系。

ecdict-attempt.example: She attempted to explain the result without using technical language.
ecdict-attempt.exampleZh: 她尝试不用专业术语来解释这个结果。
ecdict-attempt.collocationsText:
attempt to solve a problem · 尝试解决一个问题
make an attempt · 进行一次尝试
ecdict-attempt.usageNote: 动词用 attempt to do；名词常用 an attempt to do 或 an attempt at something。

ecdict-calculate.example: We calculated the total cost before choosing a printing service.
ecdict-calculate.exampleZh: 我们在选择印刷服务之前计算了总费用。
ecdict-calculate.collocationsText:
calculate the average · 计算平均值
calculate the cost · 计算费用
ecdict-calculate.usageNote: calculate 强调用数字或步骤算出结果；estimate 强调在信息不完全时作估算。

ecdict-claim.example: The advertisement claims that the new battery lasts twice as long.
ecdict-claim.exampleZh: 这则广告声称，新电池的续航时间是原来的两倍。
ecdict-claim.collocationsText:
claim that · 声称……
support a claim · 支持一项主张
ecdict-claim.usageNote: claim that 表示“声称……”，不代表说话内容已获证实；写作中应区分主张与证据。

ecdict-classify.example: The researchers classified the responses according to their main topic.
ecdict-classify.exampleZh: 研究人员按主要话题对回答进行了分类。
ecdict-classify.collocationsText:
classify into categories · 分成不同类别
classify as · 把……归类为
ecdict-classify.usageNote: classify something as 表示“把……归为”；classify something into groups 表示“把……分成几组”。

ecdict-compare.example: Compare the two graphs before deciding whether the pattern has changed.
ecdict-compare.exampleZh: 判断变化模式是否改变之前，请先比较这两张图。
ecdict-compare.collocationsText:
compare results · 比较结果
compare prices · 比较价格
ecdict-compare.usageNote: 比较异同时可用 compare A with/to B；把一物比作另一物时常用 compare A to B。

ecdict-concern.example: The survey revealed widespread concern about the loss of local shops.
ecdict-concern.exampleZh: 调查显示，人们普遍担忧本地商店不断减少。
ecdict-concern.collocationsText:
concern about safety · 对安全的担忧
a growing concern · 日益加剧的担忧；越来越受关注的问题
ecdict-concern.usageNote: concern about/over 后接令人担忧的事情；be concerned about 表示“对……感到担心”。

ecdict-correspond.example: The numbers on the map correspond to the entries in the guide.
ecdict-correspond.exampleZh: 地图上的数字与指南中的条目一一对应。
ecdict-correspond.collocationsText:
correspond to · 与……对应
correspond with a colleague · 与同事通信
ecdict-correspond.usageNote: correspond to 常表示“与……对应”；correspond with someone 表示“与某人通信”。

ecdict-critical.example: The team had to make a critical decision before the trial began.
