ecdict-critical.exampleZh: 试验开始前，团队必须作出一个关键决定。
ecdict-critical.collocationsText:
a critical stage · 关键阶段
be critical to success · 对成功至关重要
ecdict-critical.usageNote: critical 可表示“关键的”或“批评的”，要结合搭配判断；critical to 表示“对……至关重要”。

ecdict-fluctuate.example: Attendance fluctuated during the first month, then became more stable.
ecdict-fluctuate.exampleZh: 第一个月的出席人数时多时少，之后变得较为稳定。
ecdict-fluctuate.collocationsText:
fluctuate between · 在……之间波动
fluctuate widely · 大幅波动
ecdict-fluctuate.usageNote: fluctuate 强调反复升降或变化；常用 fluctuate between A and B 或 fluctuate around a figure。

ecdict-formulate.example: The students formulated a research question before collecting any data.
ecdict-formulate.exampleZh: 学生们在收集任何数据之前先明确了研究问题。
ecdict-formulate.collocationsText:
formulate a plan · 制订计划
formulate a hypothesis · 提出假设
ecdict-formulate.usageNote: formulate 强调经过思考后明确表述或制订，常接 question、plan、policy 或 theory。

ecdict-differ.example: The two accounts differ in their description of what happened next.
ecdict-differ.exampleZh: 这两份叙述对接下来发生的事情有不同的描述。
ecdict-differ.collocationsText:
differ from · 与……不同
differ in size · 大小不同
ecdict-differ.usageNote: differ from 指“与……不同”；differ in 指“在某方面不同”；形容词形式为 different。

ecdict-effect.example: The report examines the effect of noise on concentration.
ecdict-effect.exampleZh: 这份报告考察了噪声对注意力的影响。
ecdict-effect.collocationsText:
a long-term effect · 长期影响
take effect · 生效
ecdict-effect.usageNote: 表示“影响”时 effect 通常是名词，常用 the effect of A on B；affect 通常是动词。

ecdict-infer.example: Readers can infer the speaker's attitude from her choice of words.
ecdict-infer.exampleZh: 读者可以从说话者的用词推断出她的态度。
ecdict-infer.collocationsText:
infer from evidence · 根据证据推断
infer that · 推断……
ecdict-infer.usageNote: infer 表示读者或听者根据线索“推断”；imply 表示作者或说话者“暗示”。

ecdict-investigate.example: The council is investigating why several buses arrived late on the same route.
ecdict-investigate.exampleZh: 市政委员会正在调查同一线路上多辆公交车晚点的原因。
ecdict-investigate.collocationsText:
investigate the cause · 调查原因
investigate a complaint · 调查投诉
ecdict-investigate.usageNote: investigate 后可直接接事件、问题或 why/how 从句，一般不用 investigate about something。

ecdict-limit.example: We limited the discussion to issues that required an immediate decision.
ecdict-limit.exampleZh: 我们把讨论范围限定在需要立即作出决定的问题上。
ecdict-limit.collocationsText:
a time limit · 时间限制
limit access to · 限制对……的使用或访问
ecdict-limit.usageNote: limit A to B 表示“把 A 限制在 B 范围内”；名词搭配常用 a limit on something。

ecdict-link.example: The new footbridge links the station to the university campus.
ecdict-link.exampleZh: 新的人行桥把车站与大学校园连接起来。
ecdict-link.collocationsText:
a link between · ……之间的联系
link theory to practice · 把理论与实践联系起来
ecdict-link.usageNote: link A to/with B 表示“把 A 与 B 连接或联系起来”；名词常用 a link between A and B。

ecdict-measure.example: The researchers measured water quality at six points along the river.
ecdict-measure.exampleZh: 研究人员在沿河六个地点测量了水质。
ecdict-measure.collocationsText:
measure temperature · 测量温度
measure progress · 衡量进展
ecdict-measure.usageNote: measure 作动词表示“测量”；作名词时还可表示“措施”，如 safety measures（安全措施）。

ecdict-monitor.example: Volunteers monitor the river level after heavy rain.
ecdict-monitor.exampleZh: 大雨过后，志愿者会监测河流水位。
ecdict-monitor.collocationsText:
monitor changes · 监测变化
monitor performance · 监测表现或运行情况
ecdict-monitor.usageNote: monitor 作动词强调一段时间内持续观察或检查；也可作名词，表示“监视器、显示器”等。

ecdict-outcome.example: The outcome of the discussion was an agreement to test both designs.
ecdict-outcome.exampleZh: 讨论的结果是大家同意测试两种设计。
ecdict-outcome.collocationsText:
a positive outcome · 积极的结果
the final outcome · 最终结果
ecdict-outcome.usageNote: outcome 是可数名词，常用 the outcome of；强调某项活动或过程最后产生的结果。

ecdict-pattern.example: A clear pattern appeared when we arranged the records by season.
ecdict-pattern.exampleZh: 我们按季节排列记录后，一种清晰的规律显现出来。
ecdict-pattern.collocationsText:
a pattern of behaviour · 行为模式
identify a pattern · 识别规律
ecdict-pattern.usageNote: pattern 可表示“图案”或反复出现的“模式、规律”；阅读数据时要结合语境判断。

ecdict-potential.example: The empty building has the potential to become a community arts centre.
ecdict-potential.exampleZh: 这座空置建筑有潜力改造成社区艺术中心。
ecdict-potential.collocationsText:
have the potential to · 有潜力……
potential benefits · 潜在益处
ecdict-potential.usageNote: potential 作名词表示“潜力”时通常不可数，常接 to do；作形容词时表示“潜在的、可能的”。

ecdict-predict.example: The model predicts how traffic will change when the new road opens.
ecdict-predict.exampleZh: 这个模型预测了新道路开放后交通状况将如何变化。
ecdict-predict.collocationsText:
predict the outcome · 预测结果
predict accurately · 准确预测
ecdict-predict.usageNote: predict 后可接名词或 that/what/how 从句；表示对未来的预测，不等于保证结果必然发生。

ecdict-prevent.example: A clear filing system can prevent important documents from being lost.
ecdict-prevent.exampleZh: 清晰的归档系统可以防止重要文件丢失。
ecdict-prevent.collocationsText:
prevent accidents · 预防事故
prevent something from happening · 防止某事发生
ecdict-prevent.usageNote: 常用 prevent someone/something from doing；from 后接动词-ing，不能接动词原形。

ecdict-priority.example: Improving access for wheelchair users is a priority in the renovation plan.
ecdict-priority.exampleZh: 改善轮椅使用者的通行条件是这项改造计划的优先事项。
ecdict-priority.collocationsText:
give priority to · 优先考虑……
a top priority · 首要任务
ecdict-priority.usageNote: priority 可指可数的“优先事项”，也可指不可数的“优先权”；常用 give priority to。

ecdict-procedure.example: All volunteers follow the same procedure for recording a visitor's request.
ecdict-procedure.exampleZh: 所有志愿者都按照同一套程序记录访客的请求。
ecdict-procedure.collocationsText:
follow a procedure · 遵循程序
a standard procedure · 标准程序
ecdict-procedure.usageNote: procedure 指为完成某事而遵循的一套步骤或手续；process 的含义更广，还可指自然发生的过程。

ecdict-propose.example: The students proposed turning the unused courtyard into a reading area.
ecdict-propose.exampleZh: 学生们提议把闲置庭院改成阅读区。
ecdict-propose.collocationsText:
propose a solution · 提出解决方案
propose a change · 提议作出改变
ecdict-propose.usageNote: 表示建议做某事可用 propose doing 或 propose that；propose to do 常表示自己打算做某事。

ecdict-prove.example: These records prove that the bridge existed before the town was founded.
ecdict-prove.exampleZh: 这些记录证明，这座桥在城镇建立之前就已经存在。
ecdict-prove.collocationsText:
prove a point · 证明一个观点
prove to be useful · 证明是有用的
ecdict-prove.usageNote: prove that 后接要证明的内容；prove to be 后接身份或性质，表示“结果证明是”。

ecdict-reflect.example: The revised timetable reflects the needs of people who work late.
ecdict-reflect.exampleZh: 修订后的时刻表反映了晚下班人群的需求。
ecdict-reflect.collocationsText:
reflect a change · 反映变化
reflect public opinion · 反映公众意见
ecdict-reflect.usageNote: reflect 可直接接名词表示“反映”；reflect on 表示“认真思考”，不要混淆两种结构。

ecdict-reinforce.example: Short practice sessions reinforce the skills introduced in each lesson.
ecdict-reinforce.exampleZh: 简短的练习可以巩固每节课介绍的技能。
ecdict-reinforce.collocationsText:
reinforce a message · 强化一项信息
reinforce learning · 巩固所学
ecdict-reinforce.usageNote: reinforce 表示使已有的观点、能力或结构更牢固，常接 message、belief、learning 或 structure。

ecdict-represent.example: Each dot on the map represents a public drinking fountain.
ecdict-represent.exampleZh: 地图上的每一个点都代表一处公共饮水设施。
ecdict-represent.collocationsText:
represent a group · 代表一个群体
represent a proportion · 占一定比例
ecdict-represent.usageNote: represent 可表示“代表”某人或群体，也可表示符号“表示”某物；通常直接接宾语。

ecdict-resolve.example: The team resolved the scheduling problem by moving one workshop online.
ecdict-resolve.exampleZh: 团队把一场工作坊改为线上举行，解决了日程安排问题。
ecdict-resolve.collocationsText:
resolve a dispute · 解决争端
resolve a problem · 解决问题
ecdict-resolve.usageNote: resolve a problem/dispute 表示“解决问题／争端”；resolve to do 则表示“下定决心做某事”。

ecdict-restrict.example: The museum restricts photography in rooms containing delicate artworks.
ecdict-restrict.exampleZh: 博物馆在陈列精细易损艺术品的展厅内限制拍照。
ecdict-restrict.collocationsText:
restrict access · 限制进入或使用
be restricted to · 仅限于……
ecdict-restrict.usageNote: restrict something to 表示“把……限定于”；be restricted to 表示“仅限于”。

ecdict-review.example: The committee will review the plan after receiving comments from residents.
ecdict-review.exampleZh: 收到居民的意见后，委员会将重新审查这项计划。
ecdict-review.collocationsText:
review the evidence · 审查证据
a literature review · 文献综述
ecdict-review.usageNote: review 可作动词或名词，表示“审查、回顾、复习”；a review of 常用于报告、书评等。

ecdict-revise.example: She revised the introduction after a classmate pointed out an unclear sentence.
ecdict-revise.exampleZh: 一位同学指出其中一句话不清楚后，她修改了引言。
ecdict-revise.collocationsText:
revise a draft · 修改草稿
revise an estimate · 修正估计
ecdict-revise.usageNote: 这里 revise 表示重新检查并修改文字、计划或估计；revision 是名词，表示“修改、修订”。

ecdict-sample.example: The researchers selected a sample of households from several different neighbourhoods.
ecdict-sample.exampleZh: 研究人员从几个不同的社区抽取了部分家庭作为样本。
ecdict-sample.collocationsText:
a representative sample · 有代表性的样本
a water sample · 水样
ecdict-sample.usageNote: sample 可以指研究中的“样本”或商品、材料的“样品”；a sample of 后接取样对象。

ecdict-scope.example: The report's scope is limited to public transport within the city.
ecdict-scope.exampleZh: 这份报告的范围仅限于市内公共交通。
ecdict-scope.collocationsText:
beyond the scope of · 超出……的范围
scope for improvement · 改进的空间
ecdict-scope.usageNote: scope 表示“范围”时通常不可数；within/beyond the scope of 分别表示“在……范围内／超出……范围”。

ecdict-seek.example: The team sought advice from local residents before choosing a site.
ecdict-seek.exampleZh: 团队在选址前征求了当地居民的意见。
ecdict-seek.collocationsText:
seek advice · 寻求建议
seek permission · 征求许可
ecdict-seek.usageNote: seek 的过去式和过去分词都是 sought；seek advice/help 不加 for；seek to do 表示“力求做某事”。

ecdict-select.example: The editor selected three photographs that showed the changes most clearly.
ecdict-select.exampleZh: 编辑挑选了三张最能清楚展示变化的照片。
ecdict-select.collocationsText:
select at random · 随机选择
select for inclusion · 选入；选中收录
ecdict-select.usageNote: select 强调按条件挑选；select A from B 表示“从 B 中选出 A”，selected 是其过去式和过去分词。

ecdict-specify.example: The instructions specify which files must be included with the application.
ecdict-specify.exampleZh: 说明中明确列出了申请时必须附上的文件。
ecdict-specify.collocationsText:
specify a deadline · 明确规定截止时间
specify requirements · 明确规定要求
ecdict-specify.usageNote: specify 表示明确说明细节，可接名词、that 从句或疑问词从句；不要用 specify about something。

ecdict-strategy.example: Her strategy was to read the questions before examining the passage in detail.
ecdict-strategy.exampleZh: 她的策略是在仔细阅读文章之前先看问题。
ecdict-strategy.collocationsText:
a long-term strategy · 长期策略
an effective strategy · 有效的策略
ecdict-strategy.usageNote: strategy 是可数名词，强调为达成目标而制定的整体安排；常用 a strategy for doing something。

ecdict-submit.example: Please submit your abstract through the conference website by Friday.
ecdict-submit.exampleZh: 请最迟在星期五通过会议网站提交摘要。
ecdict-submit.collocationsText:
submit a proposal · 提交提案
submit for review · 提交审核
ecdict-submit.usageNote: submit A to B 表示“向 B 提交 A”；过去式和过去分词为 submitted，需双写 t。

ecdict-summarize.example: The final paragraph summarizes the main reasons for the recommendation.
ecdict-summarize.exampleZh: 最后一段概括了提出这项建议的主要理由。
ecdict-summarize.collocationsText:
summarize the findings · 概括研究发现
summarize the main points · 概括要点
ecdict-summarize.usageNote: summarize 后直接接需要概括的内容；summary 是名词；英式拼写也可用 summarise。

ecdict-sustain.example: The project needs regular funding to sustain its weekly workshops.
ecdict-sustain.exampleZh: 这个项目需要稳定的资金支持，才能继续每周开展工作坊。
ecdict-sustain.collocationsText:
sustain interest · 保持兴趣
sustain growth · 保持增长
ecdict-sustain.usageNote: sustain 在这里表示“使持续、维持”，强调让某种活动或状态延续；常接 interest、growth 或 effort。

ecdict-trend.example: The graph shows a steady trend towards smaller households.
ecdict-trend.exampleZh: 图表显示，家庭规模正呈现稳步缩小的趋势。
ecdict-trend.collocationsText:
an upward trend · 上升趋势
reverse a trend · 扭转趋势
ecdict-trend.usageNote: trend 强调一段时间内变化的总体方向；常用 a trend towards something 或 an upward/downward trend。

ecdict-verify.example: The editor verified the quotation by checking the original recording.
ecdict-verify.exampleZh: 编辑通过核对原始录音查证了这段引语。
ecdict-verify.collocationsText:
verify the accuracy of · 核实……的准确性
verify information · 核实信息
ecdict-verify.usageNote: verify 强调通过核查确认某事准确或真实，可接名词或 that 从句；不是仅凭猜测表示赞同。

ecdict-assumption.example: The plan rests on the assumption that visitor numbers will remain stable.
ecdict-assumption.exampleZh: 这项计划建立在访客人数会保持稳定的假设之上。
ecdict-assumption.collocationsText:
make an assumption · 作出假设
challenge an assumption · 质疑一项假设
ecdict-assumption.usageNote: assumption 指暂时接受但未必已证明的前提；常用 the assumption that 或 an assumption about。

ecdict-comparison.example: A comparison of the two timetables shows that the later service is faster.
ecdict-comparison.exampleZh: 比较这两份时刻表可以发现，较晚出发的那班车反而更快。
ecdict-comparison.collocationsText:
make a comparison · 进行比较
in comparison with · 与……相比
ecdict-comparison.usageNote: 可用 a comparison of A and B 或 a comparison between A and B；in comparison with 表示“与……相比”。

ecdict-definition.example: The essay begins with a clear definition of what counts as public space.
ecdict-definition.exampleZh: 文章开头清楚界定了什么属于公共空间。
ecdict-definition.collocationsText:
a working definition · 暂供使用的定义
by definition · 按照定义；本质上
ecdict-definition.usageNote: definition of 后接需要定义的词或概念；define 是相应的动词。

ecdict-emphasis.example: The course puts greater emphasis on explaining ideas than on memorizing dates.
ecdict-emphasis.exampleZh: 这门课程更注重解释观点，而不是记忆日期。
ecdict-emphasis.collocationsText:
put emphasis on · 重视；强调……
shift the emphasis · 转移重点
ecdict-emphasis.usageNote: emphasis 通常不可数；常用 put/place emphasis on，on 后接名词或动词-ing；emphasize 是动词。

ecdict-implication.example: The implication of his comment was that the team needed more time.
ecdict-implication.exampleZh: 他那番话的言下之意是，团队需要更多时间。
ecdict-implication.collocationsText:
the implication that · ……这一言外之意
by implication · 通过暗示；含蓄地
ecdict-implication.usageNote: 这里 implication 指话语中未直接说出的“含义、暗示”；常用 the implication of 或 the implication that。

ecdict-insight.example: The interviews gave us insight into how visitors use the exhibition space.
ecdict-insight.exampleZh: 这些访谈让我们更深入地了解了访客如何使用展览空间。
ecdict-insight.collocationsText:
gain insight into · 深入了解……
provide an insight into · 使人深入了解……
ecdict-insight.usageNote: insight into 表示“对……的深入了解”；具体的见解可用可数形式 an insight 或 insights。

ecdict-reliability.example: We tested the reliability of the device by repeating the measurement each day.
ecdict-reliability.exampleZh: 我们每天重复测量，以检验这台设备的可靠性。
ecdict-reliability.collocationsText:
assess reliability · 评估可靠性
improve reliability · 提高可靠性
ecdict-reliability.usageNote: reliability 是不可数名词，表示“可靠性”；reliable 是形容词，表示“可靠的”。

ecdict-response.example: The library extended its opening hours in response to student requests.
ecdict-response.exampleZh: 图书馆应学生要求延长了开放时间。
ecdict-response.collocationsText:
in response to · 为回应……；针对……
a prompt response · 迅速的回应
ecdict-response.usageNote: response to 表示“对……的回应”；in response to 表示“作为对……的回应”；respond 是动词。

ecdict-variable.example: Temperature was the only variable that the students changed during the experiment.
ecdict-variable.exampleZh: 温度是学生们在实验中改变的唯一变量。
ecdict-variable.collocationsText:
an independent variable · 自变量
a dependent variable · 因变量
ecdict-variable.usageNote: variable 作名词表示“变量”；作形容词表示“可变的、不稳定的”，如 variable weather。

ecdict-validity.example: The reviewer questioned the validity of a conclusion based on only two interviews.
ecdict-validity.exampleZh: 审稿人质疑了仅凭两次访谈得出的结论是否成立。
ecdict-validity.collocationsText:
question the validity of · 质疑……是否成立或有效
establish validity · 确立有效性
ecdict-validity.usageNote: validity 表示“有效性、正确性”，通常不可数；研究语境中应与 reliability（可靠性）区分。
